title: I Love to Tell the Story
author: A. Katherine Hankey

slides.text:
I love to tell the story
Of unseen things above,
Of Jesus and His glory,
Of Jesus and His love.
I love to tell the story,
Because I know 'tis true;
It satisfies my longings
As nothing else can do.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
I love to tell the story,
'Twill be my theme in glory,
To tell the old, old story
Of Jesus and His love.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
I love to tell the story;
More wonderful it seems
Than all the golden fancies
Of all our golden dreams.
I love to tell the story,
It did so much for me;
And that is just the reason
I tell it now to thee.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
I love to tell the story,
'Twill be my theme in glory,
To tell the old, old story
Of Jesus and His love.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
I love to tell the story;
'Tis pleasant to repeat
What seems, each time I tell it,
More wonderfully sweet.
I love to tell the story,
For some have never heard
The message of salvation
From God's own holy Word.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
I love to tell the story,
'Twill be my theme in glory,
To tell the old, old story
Of Jesus and His love.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
I love to tell the story,
For those who know it best
Seem hungering and thirsting
To hear it like the rest.
And when, in scenes of glory,
I sing the new, new song,
'Twill be the old, old story
That I have loved so long.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
I love to tell the story,
'Twill be my theme in glory,
To tell the old, old story
Of Jesus and His love.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
I need Thee every hour,
Most gracious Lord;
No tender voice like Thine
Can peace afford.
slides.label: Verse 1
Chorus

slides.text:
I need Thee every hour,
Stay Thou nearby;
Temptations lose their power
When Thou art nigh.
slides.label: Verse 2
Chorus

slides.text:
I need Thee every hour,
In joy or pain;
Come quickly and abide,
Or life is vain.
slides.label: Verse 3
Chorus
Verse 4
Chorus

slides.text:
I need Thee every hour,
Most Holy One;
O make me Thine indeed,
Thou blessèd Son.
slides.label: Verse 5
Chorus
Verse 1

slides.text:
I surrender all, I surrender all,
All to Thee, my blessèd Savior,
I surrender all.
slides.label: Chorus
Verse 2

slides.text:
I surrender all, I surrender all,
All to Thee, my blessèd Savior,
I surrender all.
slides.label: Chorus
Verse 3

slides.text:
I surrender all, I surrender all,
All to Thee, my blessèd Savior,
I surrender all.
slides.label: Chorus
Verse 4

slides.text:
I surrender all, I surrender all,
All to Thee, my blessèd Savior,
I surrender all.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
All to Jesus I surrender;
Now I feel the sacred flame.
O the joy of full salvation!
Glory, glory, to His name!
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
I surrender all, I surrender all,
All to Thee, my blessèd Savior,
I surrender all.
slides.label: Chorus

title: I Will Sing of the Mercies
author: J. H. Fillmore

slides.text:
I will sing of the mercies of the Lord for ever,
I will sing, I will sing.
I will sing of the mercies of the Lord for ever,
I will sing of the mercies of the Lord.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
With my mouth will I make known
Thy faithfulness, Thy faithfulness.
With my mouth will I make known
Thy faithfulness to all generations.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Immortal, invisible, God only wise,
In light inaccessible hid from our eyes,
Most blessed, most glorious, the Ancient of Days,
Almighty, victorious, Thy great name we praise.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Unresting, unhasting, and silent as light,
Nor wanting, nor wasting, Thou rulest in might;
Thy justice like mountains high soaring above
Thy clouds which are fountains of goodness and love.
slides.label: Verse 2
Verse 3

slides.text:
Great Father of glory, pure Father of light,
Thine angels adore Thee, all veiling their sight;
All laud we would render: O help us to see
’Tis only the splendour of light hideth Thee.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
In heavenly love abiding,
No change my heart shall fear;
And safe is such confiding,
For nothing changes here:
The storm may roar without me,
My heart may low be laid;
But God is round about me,
And can I be dismayed?
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Wherever He may guide me,
No want shall turn me back;
My Shepherd is beside me,
And nothing can I lack:
His wisdom ever waketh,
His sight is never dim;
He knows the way He taketh,
And I will walk with Him.
slides.label: Verse 2
Verse 3

slides.text:
In the bleak midwinter,
Frosty wind made moan;
Earth stood hard as iron,
Water like a stone.
Snow had fallen, snow on snow,
Snow on snow;
In the bleak midwinter,
Long ago.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Our God, heaven cannot hold Him,
Nor earth sustain,
Heaven and earth shall flee away
When He comes to reign.
In the bleak midwinter
A stable-place sufficed
The Lord God Almighty,
Jesus Christ.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Angels and archangels
May have gathered there,
Cherubim and seraphim
Thronged the air.
But His mother only,
In her maiden bliss,
Worshipped the Beloved
With a kiss.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
What can I give Him,
Poor as I am?
If I were a shepherd,
I would bring a lamb.
If I were a wise man,
I would do my part;
Yet what I can I give Him --
Give my heart.
slides.label: Verse 4

title: In the Cross of Christ I Glory
author: John Bowring

slides.text:
In the cross of Christ I glory,
Towering o'er the wrecks of time;
All the light of sacred story
Gathers round its head sublime.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
When the woes of life o'ertake me—
Hopes deceive, and fears annoy,
Never shall the cross forsake me,
Lo! it glows with peace and joy.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
When the sun of bliss is beaming
Light and love upon my way,
From the cross the radiance streaming
Adds more luster to the day.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Bane and blessing, pain and pleasure,
By the cross are sanctified;
Peace is there that knows no measure,
Joys that through all time abide.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
In the cross of Christ I glory,
Towering o'er the wrecks of time;
All the light of sacred story
Gathers round its head sublime.
slides.label: Verse 5

title: Is Your All on the Altar?
author: Elisha A. Hoffman

slides.text:
You have longed for sweet peace,
And for faith to increase,
And have earnestly, fervently prayed;
But you cannot have rest,
Or be perfectly blest,
Until all on the altar is laid.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Is your all on the altar of sacrifice laid?
Your heart does the Spirit control?
You can only be blest,
And have peace and sweet rest,
As you yield Him your body and soul.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Would you walk with the Lord,
In the light of His Word,
And have peace and contentment alway?
You must do His sweet will,
To be free from all ill,
On the altar your all you must lay.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Is your all on the altar of sacrifice laid?
Your heart does the Spirit control?
You can only be blest,
And have peace and sweet rest,
As you yield Him your body and soul.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
O we never can know
What the Lord will bestow
Of the blessings for which we have prayed,
Till our body and soul
He doth fully control,
And our all on the altar is laid.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Is your all on the altar of sacrifice laid?
Your heart does the Spirit control?
You can only be blest,
And have peace and sweet rest,
As you yield Him your body and soul.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Who can tell all the love
He will send from above,
And how happy our hearts will be made,
Of the fellowship sweet
We shall share at His feet,
When our all on the altar is laid.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Is your all on the altar of sacrifice laid?
Your heart does the Spirit control?
You can only be blest,
And have peace and sweet rest,
As you yield Him your body and soul.
slides.label: Chorus

title: It Came Upon a Midnight Clear
author: E. H. Sears

slides.text:
It came upon a midnight clear,
That glorious song of old,
From angels bending near the earth
To touch their harps of gold:
‘Peace on the earth, goodwill to men
From heaven’s all gracious King!’
The world in solemn stillness lay
To hear the angels sing.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Still through the cloven skies they come,
With peaceful wings unfurled,
And still their heavenly music floats
O’er all the weary world:
Above its sad and lowly plains
They bend on hovering wing,
And ever o’er its Babel sounds
The blessed angels sing.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Yet with woes of sin and strife
The world has suffered long,
Beneath the angel-strain have rolled
Two thousand years of wrong;
And man, at war with man, hears not
The love-song which they bring:
O hush the noise, ye men of strife,
And hear the angels sing.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
For lo! the days are hastening on,
By prophet bards foretold,
When with the ever-circling years
Comes round the age of gold;
When peace shall over all the earth
Its ancient splendours fling,
And all the world send back the song
Which now the angels sing.
slides.label: Verse 4

title: It is a Thing Most Wonderful
author: W. W. How

slides.text:
It is a thing most wonderful,
Almost too wonderful to be,
That God’s own Son should come from heaven
And die to save a child like me.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
And yet I know that it is true;
He came to this poor world below,
And wept, and toiled, and mourned, and died,
Only because He loved us so.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
I cannot tell how He could love
A child so weak and full of sin;
His love must be most wonderful,
If He could die my love to win.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
It is most wonderful to know
His love for me so free and sure;
But ’tis more wonderful to see
My love for Him so faint and poor.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
And yet I want to love Thee, Lord;
O light the flame within my heart,
And I will love Thee more and more,
Until I see Thee as Thou art.
slides.label: Verse 5

title: It Is Well With My Soul
author: Horatio G. Spafford

slides.text:
When peace, like a river,
Attendeth my way,
When sorrows like sea billows roll;
Whatever my lot,
Thou has taught me to say,
It is well, it is well, with my soul.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
It is well, with my soul,
It is well, with my soul,
It is well, it is well, with my soul.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Though Satan should buffet,
Though trials should come,
Let this blest assurance control,
That Christ has regarded
My helpless estate,
And hath shed His own blood for my soul.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
It is well, with my soul,
It is well, with my soul,
It is well, it is well, with my soul.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
My sin—oh, the bliss of
This glorious thought—
My sin—not in part but the whole,
Is nailed to the cross,
And I bear it no more,
Praise the Lord, praise the Lord, O my soul!
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
It is well, with my soul,
It is well, with my soul,
It is well, it is well, with my soul.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
For me, be it Christ,
Be it Christ hence to live:
If Jordan above me shall roll,
No pang shall be mine,
For in death as in life
Thou wilt whisper Thy peace to my soul.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
It is well, with my soul,
It is well, with my soul,
It is well, it is well, with my soul.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
But, Lord, ‘tis for Thee,
For Thy coming we wait,
The sky, not the grave, is our goal;
Oh trump of the angel!
Oh voice of the Lord!
Blessèd hope, blessèd rest of my soul!
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
It is well, with my soul,
It is well, with my soul,
It is well, it is well, with my soul.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
And Lord, haste the day
When my faith shall be sight,
The clouds be rolled back as a scroll;
The trump shall resound,
And the Lord shall descend,
Even so—it is well with my soul.
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
It is well, with my soul,
It is well, with my soul,
It is well, it is well, with my soul.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Jesus calls us over the tumult
Of our life's wild, restless, sea;
Day by day His sweet voice soundeth,
Saying, Christian, follow Me!
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
As of old Saint Andrew heard it
By the Galilean lake,
Turned from home and toil and kindred,
Leaving all for Jesus' sake.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Jesus calls us from the worship
Of the vain world's golden store,
From each idol that would keep us,
Saying, Christian, love Me more!
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
In our joys and in our sorrows,
Days of toil and hours of ease,
Still He calls, in cares and pleasures,
Christian, love Me more than these!
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Jesus calls us! By Thy mercies,
Savior may we hear Thy call,
Give our hearts to Thine obedience,
Serve and love Thee best of all.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Jesus Christ is risen today; Hallelujah!
Our triumphant holy day; Hallelujah!
Who did once upon the cross; Hallelujah!
Suffer to redeem our loss; Hallelujah!
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Hymns of praise then let us sing; Hallelujah!
Unto Christ our heavenly King; Hallelujah!
Who endured the cross and grave; Hallelujah!
Sinners to redeem and save: Hallelujah!
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
But the pains which He endured; Hallelujah!
Our salvation have procured; Hallelujah!
Now in heaven above He’s King; Hallelujah!
Where the angels ever sing: Hallelujah!
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Jesus lives! thy terrors now
Can, O death, no more appal us;
Jesus lives! by this we know,
Thou, O grave, canst not enthral us.
Hallelujah!
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Jesus lives! henceforth is death
But the gate of life immortal;
This shall calm our trembling breath,
When we pass its gloomy portal.
Hallelujah!
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Jesus lives! for us He died;
Then, alone to Jesus living,
Pure in heart may we abide,
Glory to our Saviour giving.
Hallelujah!
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Jesus lives! our hearts know well,
Naught from us His love shall sever;
Life, nor death, nor powers of hell,
Tear us from His keeping ever.
Hallelujah!
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Jesus lives! to Him the throne
Over all the world is given:
May we go where He is gone,
Rest and reign with Him in heaven.
Hallelujah!
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Jesus, lover of my soul,
Let me to Thy bosom fly,
While the nearer waters roll,
While the tempest still is high;
Hide me, O my Saviour, hide,
Till the storm of life is past;
Safe into the haven guide,
O receive my soul at last.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Other refuge have I none,
Hangs my helpless soul on Thee;
Leave, ah, leave me not alone,
Still support and comfort me.
All my trust on Thee is stayed,
All my help from Thee I bring;
Cover my defenceless head
With the shadow of Thy wing.
slides.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4

slides.text:
Jesus shall reign where’er the sun
Doth his successive journeys run;
His kingdom stretch from shore to shore,
Till moons shall wax and wane no more.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
For Him shall endless prayer be made,
And praises throng to crown His head;
His name like sweet perfume shall rise
With every morning sacrifice.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
People and realms of every tongue
Dwell on His love with sweetest song,
And infant voices shall proclaim
Their early blessings on His name.
slides.label: Verse 3
Verse 4

slides.text:
Let every creature rise and bring
Peculiar honours to our King;
Angels descend with songs again,
And earth repeat the loud Amen!
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Jesus stand among us,
In Thy risen power,
Let this time of worship
Be a hallowed hour.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Breathe Thy Holy Spirit
Into every heart,
Bid the fears and sorrows
From each soul depart.
Thus with quickened footsteps
We’ll pursue our way,
Watching for the dawning
Of eternal day.
slides.label: Verse 2

title: Jesus the Name High Over All
author: Charles Wesley

slides.text:
Jesus! The name high over all,
In hell, or earth, or sky;
Angels and men before it fall,
And devils fear and fly,
And devils fear and fly.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Jesus! the name to sinners dear,
The name to sinners given;
It scatters all their guilty fear,
It turns their hell to heaven,
It turns their hell to heaven.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Jesus! the prisoners’ fetters breaks,
And bruises Satan’s head;
Power into strengthless souls it speaks,
And life into the dead,
And life into the dead.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
O that the world might taste and see
The riches of His grace!
The arms of love that compass me
Would all mankind embrace,
Would all mankind embrace.
His only righteousness I show,
His saving grace proclaim;
’Tis all my business here below
To cry: ‘Behold the Lamb!’
To cry: ‘Behold the Lamb!’
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Happy if with my latest breath
I might but gasp His name;
Preach Him to all, and cry in death:
‘Behold, behold the Lamb!’
‘Behold, behold the Lamb!’
slides.label: Verse 5

title: Jesus, I My Cross Have Taken
author: Henry F. Lyte

slides.text:
Jesus, I my cross have taken,
All to leave and follow Thee.
Destitute, despised, forsaken,
Thou from hence my all shalt be.
Perish, every fond ambition,
All I've sought, and hoped, and known.
Yet how rich is my condition—
God and Heav'n are still mine own!
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Let the world despise and leave me—
They have left my Savior, too—
Human hearts and looks deceive me;
Thou art not, like them, untrue;
And while Thou shalt smile upon me,
God of wisdom, love and might,
Foes may hate and friends disown me:
Show Thy face, and all is bright.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Go then, earthly fame and treasure!
Come, disaster, scorn and pain!
In Thy service, pain is pleasure;
With Thy favor, loss is gain.
I have called Thee Abba, Father;
I have set my heart on Thee:
Storms may howl, and clouds may gather,
All must work for good to me.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Man may trouble and distress me,
'Twill but drive me to Thy breast.
Life with trials hard may press me;
Heav'n will bring me sweeter rest.
Oh, 'tis not in grief to harm me
While Thy love is left to me!
Oh, 'twere not in joy to charm me,
Were that joy unmixed with Thee.
slides.label: Verse 4
Verse 5

slides.text:
Haste then on from grace to glory,
Armed by faith, and winged by prayer,
Heaven's eternal day's before thee,
God's own hand shall guide thee there.
Soon shall close thy earthly mission;
Swift shall pass thy pilgrim days;
Hope soon change to glad fruition,
Faith to sight, and prayer to praise.
slides.label: Verse 6

title: Jesus, Keep Me Near the Cross
author: Fanny J. Crosby

slides.text:
Jesus, keep me near the cross,
There a precious fountain
Free to all, a healing stream
Flows from Calvary's mountain.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
In the cross, in the cross,
Be my glory ever;
Till my raptured soul shall find
Rest beyond the river.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Near the cross, a trembling soul,
Love and mercy found me;
There the bright and morning star
Sheds its beams around me.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
In the cross, in the cross,
Be my glory ever;
Till my raptured soul shall find
Rest beyond the river.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Near the cross! O Lamb of God,
Bring its scenes before me;
Help me walk from day to day,
With its shadows o'er me.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
In the cross, in the cross,
Be my glory ever;
Till my raptured soul shall find
Rest beyond the river.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Near the cross I'll watch and wait
Hoping, trusting ever,
Till I reach the golden strand,
Just beyond the river.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
In the cross, in the cross,
Be my glory ever;
Till my raptured soul shall find
Rest beyond the river.
slides.label: Chorus

title: Jesus, the Very Thought of Thee
author: Bernard of Clairvaux, tr. Edward Caswall

slides.text:
Jesus, the very thought of Thee
With sweetness fills the breast;
But sweeter far Thy face to see,
And in Thy presence rest.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Nor voice can sing, nor heart can frame,
Nor can the memory find
A sweeter sound than Thy blest name,
O Savior of mankind!
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
O hope of every contrite heart,
O joy of all the meek,
To those who fall, how kind Thou art!
How good to those who seek!
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
But what to those who find? Ah, this
Nor tongue nor pen can show;
The love of Jesus, what it is,
None but His loved ones know.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Jesus, our only joy be Thou,
As Thou our prize will be;
Jesus be Thou our glory now,
And through eternity.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
O Jesus, King most wonderful
Thou Conqueror renowned,
Thou sweetness most ineffable
In whom all joys are found!
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
When once Thou visitest the heart,
Then truth begins to shine,
Then earthly vanities depart,
Then kindles love divine.
slides.label: Verse 7

slides.text:
O Jesus, light of all below,
Thou fount of living fire,
Surpassing all the joys we know,
And all we can desire.
slides.label: Verse 8

slides.text:
Jesus, may all confess Thy name,
Thy wondrous love adore,
And, seeking Thee, themselves inflame
To seek Thee more and more.
slides.label: Verse 9

slides.text:
Thee, Jesus, may our voices bless,
Thee may we love alone,
And ever in our lives express
The image of Thine own.
slides.label: Verse 10

slides.text:
O Jesus, Thou the beauty art
Of angel worlds above;
Thy name is music to the heart,
Inflaming it with love.
slides.label: Verse 11

slides.text:
Celestial sweetness unalloyed,
Who eat Thee hunger still;
Who drink of Thee still feel a void
Which only Thou canst fill.
slides.label: Verse 12
Verse 13
Verse 14

slides.text:
Jesus, our love and joy to Thee,
The virgin's holy Son,
All might and praise and glory be,
While endless ages run.
slides.label: Verse 15

slides.text:
Join all the glorious names,
Of wisdom, love, and power,
That ever mortals knew,
That angels ever bore:
All are too mean to speak His worth,
Too mean to set my Saviour forth.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Great Prophet of my God,
My tongue would bless Thy name:
By Thee the joyful news
Of our salvation came:
The joyful news of sins forgiven,
Of hell subdued and peace with heaven.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Jesus, my great High Priest,
Offered His blood, and died;
My guilty conscience seeks
No sacrifice beside:
His powerful blood did once atone,
And now it pleads before the throne.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
My Saviour and my Lord,
My Conqueror and my King,
Thy sceptre and Thy sword,
Thy reigning grace I sing:
Thine is the power; behold, I sit
In willing bonds beneath Thy feet.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Now let my soul arise,
And tread the tempter down:
My Captain leads me forth
To conquest and a crown.
March on, nor fear to win the day,
Though death and hell obstruct the way.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Should all the hosts of death,
And powers of hell unknown,
Put their most dreadful forms
Of rage and malice on,
I shall be safe; for Christ displays
Superior power and guardian grace.
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
Joy to the world! the Lord has come;
Let earth receive her King.
Let every heart prepare Him room,
And heaven and nature sing,
And heaven and nature sing,
And heaven, and heaven and nature sing!
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Joy to the earth! the Saviour reigns;
Your sweetest songs employ.
While fields and streams and hills and plains
Repeat the sounding joy,
Repeat the sounding joy,
Repeat, repeat the sounding joy!
He rules the world with truth and grace,
And makes the nations prove
The glories of His righteousness,
The wonders of His love,
The wonders of His love,
The wonders, the wonders of His love.
slides.label: Verse 2
Verse 1

slides.text:
All Thy works with joy surround Thee,
Earth and Heav'n reflect Thy rays,
Stars and angels sing around Thee,
Center of unbroken praise:
Field and forest, vale and mountain,
Blooming meadow, flashing sea,
Chanting bird and flowing fountain
Call us to rejoice in Thee.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Thou art giving and forgiving,
Ever blessing, ever blest,
Well-spring of the joy of living,
Ocean-depth of happy rest!
Thou our Father, Christ our brother,
All who live in love are Thine:
Teach us how to love each other,
Lift us to the joy divine.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Mortals, join the mighty chorus,
Which the morning stars began;
Father-love is reigning o'er us,
Brother-love binds man to man.
Ever singing march we onward,
Victors in the midst of strife,
Joyful music leads us sunward
In the triumph song of life.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Just as I am, without one plea
But that Thy blood was shed for me,
And that Thou bid’st me come to Thee,
O Lamb of God, I come.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Just as I am, and waiting not
To rid my soul of one dark blot,
To Thee, whose blood can cleanse each spot,
O Lamb of God, I come.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Just as I am, though tossed about
With many a conflict, many a doubt,
Fightings and fears within, without,
O Lamb of God, I come.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Just as I am, poor, wretched, blind;
Sight, riches, healing of the mind,
Yea, all I need in Thee to find,
O Lamb of God, I come.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Just as I am, Thou wilt receive,
Wilt welcome, pardon, cleanse, relieve,
Because Thy promise I believe,
O Lamb of God, I come.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Just as I am, Thy love unknown
Has broken every barrier down;
Now to be Thine, yea, Thine alone,
O Lamb of God, I come.
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
Just as I am, of that free love
The breadth, length, depth and height to prove,
Here for a season, then above,
O Lamb of God, I come.
slides.label: Verse 7
Verse 1
Verse 2

slides.text:
Spirit of our God, descending,
Fill our hearts with heavenly joy,
Love with every passion blending,
Pleasure that can never cloy;
Thus provided, pardoned, guided,
Nothing can our peace destroy.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Lead, kindly Light, amid th'encircling gloom,
Lead Thou me on!
The night is dark, and I am far from home;
Lead Thou me on!
Keep Thou my feet; I do not ask to see
The distant scene; one step enough for me.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
I was not ever thus, nor prayed that Thou
Shouldst lead me on;
I loved to choose and see my path; but now
Lead Thou me on!
I loved the garish day, and, spite of fears,
Pride ruled my will. Remember not past years!
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
So long Thy power hath blest me, sure it still
Will lead me on.
O'er moor and fen, o'er crag and torrent,
Till the night is gone,
And with the morn those angel faces smile, which I
Have loved long since, and lost awhile!
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Meantime, along the narrow rugged path,
Thyself hast trod,
Lead, Savior, lead me home in childlike faith,
Home to my God.
To rest forever after earthly strife
In the calm light of everlasting life.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
What a fellowship, what a joy divine,
Leaning on the everlasting arms;
What a blessedness,
What a peace is mine,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Leaning, leaning,
Safe and secure from all alarms;
Leaning, leaning,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
O how sweet to walk in this pilgrim way,
Leaning on the everlasting arms;
O how bright the path
Grows from day to day,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Leaning, leaning,
Safe and secure from all alarms;
Leaning, leaning,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
What have I to dread? What have I to fear?
Leaning on the everlasting arms;
I have blessèd peace
With my Lord so near,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Leaning, leaning,
Safe and secure from all alarms;
Leaning, leaning,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.
slides.label: Chorus

title: Let All Mortal Flesh Keep Silence
author: Liturgy of St. James, tr. Gerard Moultrie

slides.text:
Let all mortal flesh keep silence,
And with fear and trembling stand;
Ponder nothing earthly minded,
For with blessing in His hand,
Christ our God to earth descendeth,
Our full homage to demand.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
King of kings, yet born of Mary,
As of old on earth He stood,
Lord of lords, in human vesture,
In the body and the blood;
He will give to all the faithful
His own self for heavenly food.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Rank on rank the host of Heaven
Spreads its vanguard on the way,
As the Light of light descendeth
From the realms of endless day,
That the powers of hell may vanish
As the darkness clears away.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
At His feet the six wingèd seraph,
Cherubim with sleepless eye,
Veil their faces to the presence,
As with ceaseless voice they cry:
Alleluia, Alleluia
Alleluia, Lord Most High!
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Let all the world in every corner sing:
‘My God and King!’
The heavens are not too high;
His praise may thither fly:
The earth is not too low;
His praises there may grow.
Let all the world in every corner sing:
‘My God and King!’
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Let all the world in every corner sing:
‘My God and King!’
The Church with psalms must shout,
No door can keep them out:
But, above all, the heart
Must bear the longest part.
Let all the world in every corner sing:
‘My God and King!’
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Let us break bread together on our knees (on our knees)
Let us break bread together on our knees (on our knees)
When I fall on my knees with my face to the rising sun,
O Lord, have mercy on me.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Let us drink wine together on our knees (on our knees)
Let us drink wine together on our knees (on our knees)
When I fall on my knees with my face to the rising sun,
O Lord, have mercy on me.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Let us praise God together on our knees (on our knees)
Let us praise God together on our knees (on our knees)
When I fall on my knees with my face to the rising sun,
O Lord, have mercy on me.
slides.label: Verse 3

title: Let us With a Gladsome Mind
author: John Milton

slides.text:
Let us with a gladsome mind
Praise the Lord, for He is kind:
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
For His mercies shall endure,
Ever faithful, ever sure.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Let us blaze His name abroad,
For of gods He is the God:
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
He, with all-commanding might,
Filled the new-made world with light:
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
He the golden-tressed sun
Caused all day his course to run:
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
And the silver moon by night,
’Mid her spangled sisters bright:
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
He His chosen race did bless
In the wasteful wilderness:
slides.label: Verse 7

slides.text:
All things living He doth feed,
His full hand supplies their need:
slides.label: Verse 8

slides.text:
Like a river glorious is God’s perfect peace,
Over all victorious, in its bright increase:
Perfect, yet it floweth fuller every day;
Perfect, yet it groweth deeper all the way.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Stayed upon Jehovah, hearts are fully blest;
Finding, as He promised, perfect peace and rest.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Hidden in the hollow of His blessed hand,
Never foe can follow, never traitor stand;
Not a surge of worry, not a shade of care,
Not a blast of hurry touched the Spirit there.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Every joy or trial falleth from above,
Traced upon our dial by the sun of love.
We may trust Him fully, all for us to do;
They who trust Him wholly find Him wholly true.
slides.label: Verse 4

title: Lo, He Comes With Clouds Descending
author: Charles Wesley

slides.text:
Lo, He comes with coulds descending,
Once for favoured sinners slain;
Thousand thousand saints attending
Swell the triumph of His train:
Alleluia!
Alleluia!
Alleluia!
God appears on earth to reign.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Every eye shall now behold Him
Robed in glorious majesty;
Those who set at naught and sold Him,
Pierced and nailed Him to the tree,
Deeply wailing,
Deeply wailing,
Deeply wailing,
Shall their true Messiah see.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Those dear tokens of His passion
Still His dazzling body bears;
Cause of endless exultation
To His ransomed worshippers:
With what rapture,
With what rapture,
With what rapture,
Gaze we on those glorious scars.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Yea, Amen, let all adore Thee,
High on Thine eternal throne;
Saviour, take the power and glory,
Claim the kingdom for Thine own:
Come, Lord Jesus!
Come, Lord Jesus!
Come, Lord Jesus!
Everlasting God, come down!
slides.label: Verse 4

title: Look Ye Saints The Sight is Glorious
author: Thomas Kelly

slides.text:
Look, ye saints, the sight is glorious;
See the Man of Sorrows now,
From the fight returned victorious;
Every knee to Him shall bow:
Crown Him! Crown Him!
Crown Him! Crown Him!
Crowns become the Victor’s brow.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Crown the Saviour, angels, crown Him;
Rich the trophies Jesus brings;
In the seat of power enthrone Him,
While the vault of heaven rings:
Crown Him! Crown Him!
Crown Him! Crown Him!
Crown the Saviour, King of kings!
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Sinners in derision crowned Him,
Mocking thus the Saviour’s claim;
Saints and angels throng around Him,
Own His title, praise His name:
Crown Him! Crown Him!
Crown Him! Crown Him!
Spread abroad the Victor’s fame.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Hark, those bursts of acclamation!
Hark, those loud triumphant chords!
Jesus takes the highest station:
O what joy the sight affords!
Crown Him! Crown Him!
Crown Him! Crown Him!
King of kings, and Lord of lords!
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Lord, enthroned in heavenly splendour,
First-begotten from the dead,
Thou alone, our strong Defender,
Liftest up Thy people’s head.
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Jesus, true and living Bread.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Here our humblest homage pay we,
Here in loving reverence bow;
Here for faith’s discernment pray we,
Lest we fail to know Thee now.
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Thou art here, we ask not how.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Though the lowliest form doth veil Thee
As of old in Bethlehem,
Here as there Thine angels hail Thee
Branch and Flower of Jesse’s stem.
Alleluia! Alleluia!
We in worship join with them.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Paschal Lamb, Thine offering, finished
Once for all when Thou wast slain,
In its fulness undiminished
Shall forever more remain,
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Cleansing souls from every stain.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Life-imparting, heavenly Manna,
Stricken Rock with streaming side,
Heaven and earth with loud hosanna
Worship Thee, the Lamb who died,
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Risen, ascended, glorified!
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Lord, speak to me that I may speak
In living echoes of Thy tone;
As Thou has sought, so let me seek
Thine erring children lost and lone.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
O lead me, Lord, that I may lead
The wandering and the wavering feet;
O feed me, Lord, that I may feed
Thy hungering ones with manna sweet.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
O strengthen me, that while I stand
Firm on the rock, and strong in Thee,
I may stretch out a loving hand
To wrestlers with the troubled sea.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
O teach me, Lord, that I may teach
The precious things Thou dost impart;
And wing my words, that they may reach
The hidden depths of many a heart.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
O give Thine own sweet rest to me,
That I may speak with soothing power
A word in season, as from Thee,
To weary ones in needful hour.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
O fill me with Thy fullness, Lord,
Until my very heart overflow
In kindling thought and glowing word,
Thy love to tell, Thy praise to show.
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
O use me, Lord, use even me,
Just as Thou wilt, and when, and where,
Until Thy blessèd face I see,
Thy rest, Thy joy, Thy glory share.
slides.label: Verse 7

slides.text:
Love came down at Christmas,
Love all lovely, Love divine;
Love was born at Christmas,
Star and angels gave the sign.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Worship we the Godhead,
Love Incarnate, Love divine;
Worship we our Jesus:
But wherewith for sacred sign?
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Love shall be our token,
Love be yours and love be mine,
Love to God and all men,
Love for plea and gift and sign.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Love divine, all loves excelling,
Joy of heaven to earth come down!
Fix in us Thy humble dwelling,
All Thy faithful mercies crown.
Jesus, Thou art all compassion,
Pure unbounded love Thou art;
Visit us with Thy salvation,
Enter every trembling heart.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Breathe, O breathe Thy loving Spirit
Into every troubled breast!
Let us all in Thee inherit,
Let us find Thy promised rest.
Take away the love of sinning;
Alpha and Omega be;
End of faith, as its beginning,
Set our hearts at liberty.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Come, Almighty to deliver,
Let us all Thy grace receive;
Suddenly return, and never,
Never more Thy temples leave.
Thee we would be always blessing,
Serve Thee as Thy hosts above,
Pray, and praise Thee without ceasing,
Glory in Thy perfect love.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Finish then Thy new creation,
Pure and spotless let us be;
Let us see Thy great salvation
Perfectly restored in Thee!
Changed from glory into glory,
Till in heaven we take our place;
Till we cast our crowns before Thee,
Lost in wonder, love and praise.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
I was sinking deep in sin,
Far from the peaceful shore,
Very deeply stained within,
Sinking to rise no more,
But the Master of the sea,
Heard my despairing cry,
From the waters lifted me,
Now safe am I.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Love lifted me! Love lifted me!
When nothing else could help
Love lifted me!
Love lifted me! Love lifted me!
When nothing else could help
Love lifted me!
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
All my heart to Him I give,
Ever to Him I'll cling
In His blessèd presence live,
Ever His praises sing,
Love so mighty and so true,
Merits my soul's best songs,
Faithful, loving service too,
To Him belongs.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Love lifted me! Love lifted me!
When nothing else could help
Love lifted me!
Love lifted me! Love lifted me!
When nothing else could help
Love lifted me!
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Souls in danger look above,
Jesus completely saves,
He will lift you by His love,
Out of the angry waves.
He's the Master of the sea,
Billows His will obey,
He your Savior wants to be,
Be saved today.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Love lifted me! Love lifted me!
When nothing else could help
Love lifted me!
Love lifted me! Love lifted me!
When nothing else could help
Love lifted me!
slides.label: Chorus

title: Low in The Grave He Lay
author: Robert Lowry

slides.text:
Low in the grave he lay,
Jesus, my Saviour,
Waiting the coming day,
Jesus, my Lord:
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Up from the grave He arose,
With a mighty triumph o’er His foes;
He arose a Victor from the dark domain,
And He lives for ever with His saints to reign:
He arose! He arose!
Alleluia! Christ arose!
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Vainly they watch His bed,
Jesus, my Saviour;
Vainly they seal the dead,
Jesus, my Lord:
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Death cannot keep his prey,
Jesus, my Saviour;
He tore the bars away,
Jesus, my Lord:
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Out in the highways and byways of life,
Many are weary and sad;
Carry the sunshine where darkness is rife,
Making the sorrowing glad.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Make me a blessing, make me a blessing,
Out of my life may Jesus shine;
Make me a blessing, O Savior, I pray,
Make me a blessing to someone today.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Tell the sweet story of Christ and His love,
Tell of His pow'r to forgive;
Others will trust Him if only you prove
True, every moment you live.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Make me a blessing, make me a blessing,
Out of my life may Jesus shine;
Make me a blessing, O Savior, I pray,
Make me a blessing to someone today.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Give as 'twas given to you in your need,
Love as the Master loved you;
Be to the helpless a helper indeed,
Unto your mission be true.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Make me a blessing, make me a blessing,
Out of my life may Jesus shine;
Make me a blessing, O Savior, I pray,
Make me a blessing to someone today.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Man of sorrows! what a name
For the Son of God, who came
Ruined sinners to reclaim!
Hallelujah! what a Saviour!
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Bearing shame and scoffing rude,
In my place condemned He stood;
Sealed my pardon with His blood:
Hallelujah! what a Saviour!
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Guilty, vile, and helpless, we;
Spotless Lamb of God was He:
Full atonement—can it be?
Hallelujah! what a Saviour!
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Lifted up was He to die,
‘It is finished!’ was His cry:
Now in heaven exalted high:
Hallelujah! what a Saviour!
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
When He comes, our glorious King,
All His ransomed home to bring,
Then anew this song we’ll sing:
‘Hallelujah! what a Saviour!’
slides.label: Verse 5
Verse 1

slides.text:
Speak to me by name, O Master,
Let me know it is to me;
Speak, that I may follow faster,
With a step more firm and free,
Where the Shepherd leads the flock
In the shadow of the rock.
slides.label: Verse 2
Verse 3

slides.text:
Master, speak! and make me ready,
When Thy voice is truly heard,
With obedience glad and steady
Still to follow every word.
I am listening, Lord, for Thee;
Master, speak! O speak to me!
slides.label: Verse 4

title: May the Mind of Christ my Saviour
author: Kate B. Wilkinson

slides.text:
May the mind of Christ my Saviour
Live in me from day to day,
By His love and power controlling
All I do and say.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
May the word  of God dwell richly
In my heart from hour to hour,
So that all may see I triumph
Only through His power.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
May the peace of God my Father
Rule my life in everything,
That I may be calm to comfort
Sick and sorrowing.
   
May the love of Jesus fill me,
As the waters fill the sea;
Him exalting, self abasing,
This is victory.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
May I run the race before me,
Strong and brave to face the foe,
Looking only unto Jesus,
As I onward go.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
More love to Thee, O Christ,
More love to Thee!
Hear Thou the prayer I make
On bended knee.
This is my earnest plea—
More love, O Christ, to Thee;
More love to Thee,
More love to Thee!
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Once earthly joy I craved,
Sought peace and rest;
Now Thee alone I seek,
Give what is best.
This all my prayer shall be—
More love, O Christ to Thee;
More love to Thee,
More love to Thee!
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Let sorrow do its work,
Send grief or pain;
Sweet are Thy messengers,
Sweet their refrain,
When they can sing with me—
More love, O Christ, to Thee;
More love to Thee,
More love to Thee!
slides.label: Verse 3
Verse 4

title: My Faith Looks Up to Thee
author: Ray Palmer

slides.text:
My faith looks up to Thee,
Thou Lamb of Calvary, Savior divine!
Now hear me while I pray, take all my guilt away,
O let me from this day be wholly Thine!
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
May Thy rich grace impart
Strength to my fainting heart, my zeal inspire!
As Thou hast died for me, O may my love to Thee,
Pure warm, and changeless be, a living fire!
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
While life's dark maze I tread,
And griefs around me spread, be Thou my guide;
Bid darkness turn to day, wipe sorrow's tears away,
Nor let me ever stray from Thee aside.
slides.label: Verse 3
Verse 4

title: My God How Wonderful Thou Art
author: Frederick W. Faber

slides.text:
My God, how wonderful Thou art,
Thy majesty how bright!
How beautiful Thy mercy-seat,
In depths of burning light!
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
How dread are Thine eternal years,
O everlasting Lord,
By prostrate spirits day and night
Incessantly adored!
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
How wonderful, how beautiful
The sight of Thee must be,
Thine endless wisdom, boundless power,
And awesome purity!
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
O how I fear Thee, living God,
With deepest, tenderest fears,
And worship Thee with trembling hope
And penitential tears!
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Yet I may love Thee too, O Lord,
Almighty as Thou art,
For Thou hast stooped to ask of me
The love of my poor heart.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
No earthly father loves like Thee;
No mother e’er so mild
Bears and forbears as Thou hast done
With me, Thy sinful child.
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
Father of Jesus, love’s reward,
What rapture will it be
Prostrate before Thy throne to lie,
And gaze, and gaze on Thee.
slides.label: Verse 7
Verse 1

slides.text:
I love Thee because Thou has first lovèd me,
And purchased my pardon on Calvary's tree.
I love Thee for wearing the thorns on Thy brow;
If ever I loved Thee, my Jesus, 'tis now.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
I'll love Thee in life, I will love Thee in death,
And praise Thee as long as Thou lendest me breath;
And say when the death dew lies cold on my brow,
If ever I loved Thee, my Jesus, 'tis now.
slides.label: Verse 3
Verse 4

slides.text:
My song is love unknown,
My Saviour’s love to me: 
Love to the loveless shown, 
That they might lovely be. 
O who am I, that for my sake 
My Lord should take frail flesh and die?
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
He came from His blessed throne,
Salvation to bestow; 
But men made strange, and none 
The longed-for Christ would know: 
But O! my Friend, my Friend indeed, 
Who at my need His life did spend.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Sometimes they strew His way, 
And His sweet praises sing; 
Resounding all the day 
Hosannas to their King: 
Then ‘Crucify!’ is all their breath, 
And for His death they thirst and cry.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
They rise and needs will have 
My dear Lord made away; 
A murderer they save, 
The Prince of life they slay, 
Yet cheerful He to suffering goes, 
That He His foes from thence might free.
slides.label: Verse 4
Verse 5

slides.text:
Here might I stay and sing, 
No story so divine; 
Never was love, dear King! 
Never was grief like Thine. 
This is my Friend, in whose sweet praise 
I all my days could gladly spend.
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer to Thee!
E'en though it be a cross
That raiseth me,
Still all my song would be,
slides.label: Verse 1
Chorus

slides.text:
Though like the wanderer,
The sun gone down,
Darkness be over me,
My rest a stone;
Yet in my dreams I'd be,
slides.label: Verse 2
Chorus
Verse 3
Chorus

slides.text:
Then, with my waking thoughts,
Bright with Thy praise,
Out of my stony griefs,
Bethel I'll raise;
So by my woes to be,
slides.label: Verse 4
Chorus

slides.text:
Or, if on joyful wing
Cleaving the sky,
Sun, moon, and stars forgot,
Upward I'll fly,
Still all my song shall be,
slides.label: Verse 5
Chorus

slides.text:
There in my Father's home,
Safe and at rest,
There in my Savior's love,
Perfectly blest;
Age after age to be,
slides.label: Verse 6
Chorus

slides.text:
What can wash away my sin?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
What can make me whole again?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Oh! precious is the flow
That makes me white as snow;
No other fount I know,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
For my pardon, this I see,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
For my cleansing this my plea,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Oh! precious is the flow
That makes me white as snow;
No other fount I know,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Nothing can for sin atone,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
Naught of good that I have done,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Oh! precious is the flow
That makes me white as snow;
No other fount I know,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
This is all my hope and peace,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
This is all my righteousness,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Oh! precious is the flow
That makes me white as snow;
No other fount I know,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Now by this I'll overcome—
Nothing but the blood of Jesus,
Now by this I'll reach my home—
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Oh! precious is the flow
That makes me white as snow;
No other fount I know,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Glory! Glory! This I sing—
Nothing but the blood of Jesus,
All my praise for this I bring—
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
Oh! precious is the flow
That makes me white as snow;
No other fount I know,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.
slides.label: Chorus

title: Now Thank We All Our God
author: Martin Rinkart

slides.text:
Now thank we all our God,
With hearts and hands and voices; 
Who wondrous things has done, 
In whom His world rejoices; 
Who from our mother’s arms 
Has blessed us on our way 
With countless gifts of love, 
And still is ours today.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
O may this bounteous God 
Through all our life be near us, 
With ever joyful hearts 
And blessed peace to cheer us; 
And keep us in His grace, 
And guide us when perplexed, 
And free us from all ills 
In this world and the next.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
All praise and thanks to God 
The Father now be given, 
The Son, and Him who reigns 
With them in highest heaven, 
The one eternal God, 
Whom earth and heaven adore; 
For thus it was, is now, 
And shall be ever more.
slides.label: Verse 3

title: O Breath of God Breathe on us Now
author: Alfred Vine

slides.text:
O breath of God, breathe on us now,
And move within us while we pray;
The Spring of our new life art Thou,
The very light of our new day.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
O strangely art Thou with us, Lord,
Neither in height nor depth to seek:
In nearness shall Thy voice be heard;
Spirit to spirit Thou dost speak.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Christ is our Advocate on high;
Thou art our Advocate within.
O plead the truth, and make reply
To every argument of sin.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
But ah, this faithless heart of mine,
The way I know, I know my Guide;
Forgive me, O my Friend divine,
That I so often turn aside.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Be with me when no other friend
The mystery of my heart can share;
And be Thou known, when fears transcend,
By Thy best name of Comforter.
slides.label: Verse 5

title: O Breath of Life Come Sweeping Through
author: Elizabeth Porter Head

slides.text:
O breath of life, come sweeping through us,
Revive Thy church with life and power. 
O Breath of Life, come, cleanse, renew us, 
And fit Thy church to meet this hour.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
O Wind of God, come, bend us, break us, 
Till humbly we confess our need; 
Then in Thy tenderness remake us, 
Revive, restore; for this we plead.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
O Breath of Love, come, breathe within us,
Renewing thought and will and heart: 
Come, love of Christ, afresh to win us, 
Revive Thy church in every part.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Revive us, Lord! is zeal abating 
While harvest fields are vast and white? 
Revive us, Lord, the world is waiting, 
Equip Thy church to spread the light.
slides.label: Verse 4
Verse 1

slides.text:
O come, let us adore Him, 
O come, let us adore Him, 
O come, let us adore Him, 
Christ the Lord!
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
God of God, 
Light of light, 
Lo, He abhors not the virgin’s womb; 
Very God, 
Begotten, not created:
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Sing, choirs of angels, 
Sing in exultation, 
Sing, all ye citizens of heaven above; 
Glory to God 
In the highest:
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Yea, Lord, we greet Thee, 
Born this happy morning, 
Jesus, to Thee be glory given; 
Word of the Father 
Now in flesh appearing:
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
O come, O come, Immanuuel,
And ransom captive Israel, 
That mourns in lonely exile here 
Until the Son of God appear.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Rejoice, rejoice! Immanuel 
Shall come to thee, O Israel.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
O come, O come, Thou Lord of might 
Who to Thy tribes on Sinai’s height 
In ancient times didst give the law 
In cloud, and majesty, and awe.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
O come, Thou Rod of Jesse, free 
Thine own from Satan’s tyranny; 
From depths of hell Thy people save 
And give them victory o’er the grave.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
O come, Thou Dayspring, come and cheer 
Our spirits by Thine advent here; 
Disperse the gloomy clouds of night, 
And death’s dark shadows put to flight.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
O come, Thou Key of David, come 
And open wide our heavenly home; 
Make safe the way that leads on high, 
And close the path to misery.
slides.label: Verse 6

title: O For a Closer Walk With God
author: William Cowper

slides.text:
O for a closer walk with God,
A calm and heavenly frame,
A light to shine upon the road
That leads me to the Lamb.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Where is the blessedness I knew
When I first saw the Lord?
Where is that soul-refreshing view
Of Jesus and His word?
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
What peaceful hours I once enjoyed!
How sweet their memory still!
But they have left an aching void
The world can never fill.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Return, O holy Dove! return,
Sweet messenger of rest!
I hate the sins that made Thee mourn,
And drove Thee from my breast.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
The dearest idol I have known,
Whate’er that idol be,
Help me tear if from Thy throne,
And worship only Thee.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
So shall my walk be close with God,
Calm and serene my frame;
So purer light shall mark the road
That leads me to the Lamb.
slides.label: Verse 6

title: O for a Faith That Will Not Shrink
author: William H. Bathurst

slides.text:
O, for a faith that will not shrink,
Though pressed by every foe,
That will not tremble on the brink
Of poverty or woe!
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
That will not murmur nor complain
Beneath the chastening rod;
But in the hour of grief or pain,
Will lean upon its God.
slides.label: Verse 2
Verse 3

slides.text:
That bears unmoved, the world's dread frown
Nor heeds its scornful smile;
That sin's wild ocean cannot drown,
Nor its soft arts beguile.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
A faith that keeps the narrow way
Till life's last spark is fled,
And with a pure and heavenly ray
Lights up a dying bed.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Lord, give me such a faith as this,
And then, whate'er may come,
I'll taste, e'en here, the hallowed bliss
Of an eternal home.
slides.label: Verse 6

title: O For a Heart to Praise My God
author: Charles Wesley

slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
A heart resigned, submissive, meek, 
My great Redeemer’s throne, 
Where only Christ is heard to speak, 
Where Jesus reigns alone;
slides.label: Verse 2
Verse 3

slides.text:
A heart in every thought renewed, 
And full of love divine; 
Perfect and right, and pure, and good: 
A copy, Lord, of Thine.
slides.label: Verse 4
Verse 5

slides.text:
O for a thousand tongues to sing 
My great Redeemer’s praise, 
My great Redeemer’s praise! 
The glories of my God and King, 
The triumphs of His grace!
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Jesus! the name that charms our fears, 
That bids our sorrows cease, 
That bids our sorrows cease; 
’Tis music in the sinner’s ears, 
’Tis life, and health, and peace.
slides.label: Verse 2
Verse 3

slides.text:
He breaks the power of cancelled sin, 
He sets the prisoner free, 
He sets the prisoner free; 
His blood can make the foulest clean, 
His blood availed for me.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
He speaks and, listening to His voice, 
New life the dead receive, 
New life the dead receive; 
The mournful, broken hearts rejoice, 
The humble poor believe.
slides.label: Verse 5
Verse 6

slides.text:
My gracious Master and my God, 
Assist me to proclaim, 
Assist me to proclaim, 
To spread through all the earth abroad 
The honours of Thy name.
slides.label: Verse 7

title: O God our Help in Ages Past
author: Isaac Watts

slides.text:
O God, our help in ages past,
Our hope for years to come, 
Our shelter from the stormy blast, 
And our eternal home.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Under the shadow of Thy throne 
Thy saints have dwelt secure; 
Sufficient is Thine arm alone, 
And our defence is sure.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Before the hills in order stood, 
Or earth received her frame, 
From everlasting Thou art God, 
To endless years the same.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
A thousand ages in Thy sight 
Are like an evening gone, 
Short as the watch that ends the night 
Before the rising sun.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Time, like an ever-rolling stream, 
Bears all its sons away; 
They fly forgotten, as a dream 
Dies at the opening day.
O God, our help in ages past, 
Our hope for years to come, 
Be Thou our guard while troubles last, 
And our eternal home.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
O happy day, that fixed my choice
On Thee, my Savior and my God!
Well may this glowing heart rejoice,
And tell its raptures all abroad.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Happy day, happy day,
When Jesus washed my sins away!
He taught me how to watch and pray,
And live rejoicing every day
Happy day, happy day,
When Jesus washed my sins away.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
O happy bond, that seals my vows
To Him who merits all my love!
Let cheerful anthems fill His house,
While to that sacred shrine I move.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Happy day, happy day,
When Jesus washed my sins away!
He taught me how to watch and pray,
And live rejoicing every day
Happy day, happy day,
When Jesus washed my sins away.
slides.label: Chorus
Verse 3

slides.text:
Happy day, happy day,
When Jesus washed my sins away!
He taught me how to watch and pray,
And live rejoicing every day
Happy day, happy day,
When Jesus washed my sins away.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Now rest my long divided heart,
Fixed on this blissful center, rest;
With ashes who would grudge to part
When called on angels' bread to feast?
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Happy day, happy day,
When Jesus washed my sins away!
He taught me how to watch and pray,
And live rejoicing every day
Happy day, happy day,
When Jesus washed my sins away.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
High Heaven, that heard the solemn vow,
That vow renewed shall daily hear,
Till in life's latest hour I bow
And bless in death a bond so dear.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Happy day, happy day,
When Jesus washed my sins away!
He taught me how to watch and pray,
And live rejoicing every day
Happy day, happy day,
When Jesus washed my sins away.
slides.label: Chorus

title: O Holy Night
author: Placide Cappeau, tr. John S. Dwight

slides.text:
O holy night, the stars are brightly shining;
It is the night of the dear Savior's birth!
Long lay the world in sin and error pining,
Till He appeared and the soul felt its worth.
A thrill of hope, the weary soul rejoices,
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
For yonder breaks a new and glorious morn.
Fall on your knees, O hear the angel voices!
O night divine, O night when Christ was born!
O night, O holy night, O night divine!
slides.label: Verse 1 (cont.)

slides.text:
Led by the light of a faith serenely beaming,
With glowing hearts by His cradle we stand.
So led by light of a star so sweetly gleaming,
Here came the wise men from Orient land.
The King of kings lay thus in lowly manger,
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
In all our trials born to be our friend!
He knows our need—to our weakness is no stranger.
Behold your king; before Him lowly bend!
Behold your king; before Him lowly bend!
slides.label: Verse 2 (cont.)

slides.text:
Truly He taught us to love one another;
His law is love and His Gospel is peace.
Chains shall He break, for the slave is our brother
And in His name all oppression shall cease.
Sweet hymns of joy in grateful chorus raise we,
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Let all within us praise His holy name!
Christ is the Lord! O praise His name forever!
His power and glory evermore proclaim!
His power and glory evermore proclaim!
slides.label: Verse 3 (cont.)

slides.text:
O Jesus, I have promised
To serve Thee to the end; 
Be Thou forever near me, 
My Master and my Friend; 
I shall not fear the battle 
If Thou art by my side, 
Nor wander from the pathway 
If Thou wilt be my Guide.
slides.label: Verse 1
Verse 2

slides.text:
O let me hear Thee speaking 
In accents clear and still, 
Above the storms of passion, 
The murmurs of self-will; 
O speak to reassure me, 
To hasten, or control; 
O speak, and make me listen, 
Thou Guardian of my soul.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
O Jesus, Thou hast promised 
To all who follow Thee 
That where Thou art in glory 
There shall Thy servants be; 
And, Jesus, I have promised 
To serve Thee to the end; 
O give me grace to follow 
My Master and my Friend.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
O let me see Thy footmarks, 
And in them plant mine own; 
My hope to follow duly 
Is in Thy strength alone. 
O guide me, call me, draw me, 
Uphold me to the end; 
And then in heaven receive me, 
My Saviour and my Friend.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
O Jesus, Thou art standing,
Outside the fast closed door,
In lowly patience waiting
To pass the threshold o'er:
Shame on us, Christian brothers,
His name and sign who bear,
O shame, thrice shame upon us,
To keep Him standing there!
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
O Jesus, Thou art knocking;
And lo, that hand is scarred,
And thorns Thy brow encircle,
And tears Thy face have marred:
O love that passeth knowledge,
So patiently to wait!
O sin that hath no equal,
So fast to bar the gate!
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
O Jesus, Thou art pleading
In accents meek and low,
I died for you, My children,
And will you treat Me so?
O Lord, with shame and sorrow
We open now the door;
Dear Savior, enter, enter,
And leave us nevermore.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
O little town of Bethlehem,
How still we see thee lie! 
Above thy deep and dreamless sleep 
The silent stars go by. 
Yet in thy dark streets shineth 
The everlasting Light; 
The hopes and fears of all the years 
Are met in thee tonight.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
O morning stars, together
Proclaim the holy birth,
And praises sing to God the King,
And peace to men on earth;
For Christ is born of Mary,
And gathered all above,
While mortals sleep, the angels keep
Their watch of wondering love.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
How silently, how silently
The wondrous gift is given! 
So God imparts to human hearts 
The blessings of His heaven. 
No ear may hear His coming; 
But in this world of sin, 
Where meek souls will receive Him, still 
The dear Christ enters in.
slides.label: Verse 3
Verse 4

title: O Love That Wilt Not Let Me Go
author: George Matheson

slides.text:
O love that wilt not let me go,
I rest my weary soul in thee: 
I give thee back the life I owe, 
That in thine ocean depths its flow
May richer, fuller be.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
O light that followest all my way,
I yield my flickering torch to thee: 
My heart restores its borrowed ray,
That in thy sunshine’s blaze its day
May brighter, fairer be.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
O joy that seekest me through pain,
I cannot close my heart to thee:
I trace the rainbow through the rain,
And feel the promise is not vain,
That morn shall tearless be.
O cross that liftest up my head,
I dare not ask to fly from thee:
I lay in dust life’s glory dead,
And from the ground there blossoms red
Life that shall endless be.
slides.label: Verse 3

title: O Master, Let Me Walk With Thee
author: Washington Gladden

slides.text:
O Master, let me walk with Thee,
In lowly paths of service free;
Tell me Thy secret; help me bear
The strain of toil, the fret of care.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Help me the slow of heart to move
By some clear, winning word of love;
Teach me the wayward feet to stay,
And guide them in the homeward way.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
O Master, let me walk with Thee,
Before the taunting Pharisee;
Help me to bear the sting of spite,
The hate of men who hide Thy light.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
The sore distrust of souls sincere
Who cannot read Thy judgments clear,
The dullness of the multitude,
Who dimly guess that Thou art good.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Teach me Thy patience; still with Thee
In closer, dearer, company,
In work that keeps faith sweet and strong,
In trust that triumphs over wrong.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
In hope that sends a shining ray
Far down the future's broadening way,
In peace that only Thou canst give,
With Thee, O Master, let me live.
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
O praise ye the Lord!
Praise Him in the height; 
Rejoice in His word, 
Ye angels of light; 
Ye heavens adore Him 
By whom ye were made, 
And worship before Him
In brightness arrayed.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
O praise ye the Lord! 
Praise Him upon earth, 
In tuneful accord, 
Ye sons of new birth; 
Praise Him who hath brought you 
His grace from above, 
Praise Him who hath taught you 
To sing of His love.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
O praise ye the Lord, 
All things that give sound; 
Each jubilant chord, 
Re-echo around: 
Loud organs, His glory 
Forthtell in deep tone, 
And sweet harp, the story 
Of what He hath done.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
O praise ye the Lord! 
Thanksgiving and song 
To Him be outpoured 
All ages along; 
For love in creation, 
For heaven restored, 
For grace of salvation, 
O praise ye the Lord!
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
O sacred head, once wounded,
With grief and pain weighed down, 
How scornfully surrounded 
With thorns, Thine only crown! 
How pale art Thou with anguish, 
With sore abuse and scorn! 
How does that visage languish, 
Which once was bright as morn!
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
O Lord of life and glory, 
What bliss till now was Thine! 
I read the wondrous story, 
I joy to call Thee mine. 
Thy grief and Thy compassion 
Were all for sinners’ gain; 
Mine, mine was the transgression, 
But Thine the deadly pain.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
What language shall I borrow
To praise Thee, heavenly Friend,
For this, Thy dying sorrow,
Thy pity without end?
Lord, make me Thine for ever,
Nor let me faithless prove;
O let me never, never
Abuse such dying love!
slides.label: Verse 3
Verse 4

slides.text:
O my Saviour, lifted
From the earth for me, 
Draw me, in Thy mercy, 
Nearer unto Thee.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Lift my earthbound longings, 
Fix them, Lord, above; 
Draw me with the magnet 
Of Thy mighty love.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
And I come, Lord Jesus; 
Dare I turn away? 
No! Thy love hath conquered, 
And I come today.
Bringing all my burdens,
Sorrow, sin, and care;
At Thy feet I lay them,
And I leave them there.
slides.label: Verse 3

title: O the Deep Deep Love of Jesus
author: Samuel Trevor Francis

slides.text:
O the deep, deep love of Jesus!
Vast, unmeasured, boundless, free;
Rolling as a mighty ocean
In its fulness over me.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Underneath me, all around me,
Is the current of Thy love;
Leading onward, leading homeward,
To my glorious rest above.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
O the deep, deep love of Jesus!
Spread His praise from shore to shore,
How He loveth, ever loveth,
Changeth never, nevermore;
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
How He watches o’er His loved ones,
Died to call them all His own;
How for them He intercedeth,
Watches over them from the throne.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
O the deep, deep love of Jesus!
Love of every love the best:
‘Tis an ocean vast of blessing,
‘Tis a haven sweet of rest.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
O the deep, deep love of Jesus!
‘Tis a heaven of heavens to me;
And it lifts me up to glory,
For it lifts me up to Thee.
slides.label: Verse 6

title: O Thou Who Camest From Above
author: Charles Wesley

slides.text:
O Thou who camest from above
The pure celestial fire to impart, 
Kindle a flame of sacred love 
On the mean altar of my heart.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
There let it for Thy glory burn 
With inextinguishable blaze, 
And trembling to its source return, 
In humble prayer and fervent praise.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Jesus, confirm my heart’s desire 
To work, and speak, and think for Thee; 
Still let me guard the holy fire, 
And still stir up Thy gift in me.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Ready for all Thy perfect will, 
My acts of faith and love repeat, 
Till death Thy endless mercies seal, 
And make the sacrifice complete.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
O worship the King,
All glorious above; 
O gratefully sing 
His power and His love: 
Our Shield and Defender, 
The Ancient of Days, 
Pavilioned in splendour 
And girded with praise.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
O tell of His might, 
O sing of His grace, 
Whose robe is the light, 
Whose canopy space; 
His chariots of wrath 
The deep thunder-clouds form, 
And dark is His path 
On the wings of the storm.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
The earth, with its store 
Of wonders untold, 
Almighty, Thy power 
Hath founded of old; 
Hath ’stablished it fast, 
By a changeless decree, 
And round it hath cast, 
Like a mantle, the sea.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Thy bountiful care 
What tongue can recite? 
It breathes in the air, 
It shines in the light; 
It streams from the hills, 
It descends to the plain, 
And sweetly distils 
In the dew and the rain.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Frail children of dust, 
And feeble as frail, 
In Thee do we trust, 
Nor find Thee to fail; 
Thy mercies how tender, 
How firm to the end, 
Our Maker, Defender, 
Redeemer, and Friend!
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
O worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness,
Bow down before Him, His glory proclaim;
With gold of obedience and incense of lowliness,
Kneel and adore Him; the Lord is His name.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Low at His feet lay thy burden of carefulness, 
High on His heart He will bear it for thee, 
Comfort thy sorrows, and answer thy prayerfulness, 
Guiding thy steps as may best for thee be.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Fear not to enter His courts in the slenderness 
Of the poor wealth thou wouldst reckon as thine; 
Truth in its beauty, and love in its tenderness, 
These are the offerings to lay on His shrine.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
These, though we bring them in trembling and fearfulness,
He will accept for the name that is dear;
Mornings of joy give for evenings of tearfulness,
Trust for our trembling, and hope for our fear.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
O worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness, 
Bow down before Him, His glory proclaim; 
With gold of obedience and incense of lowliness, 
Kneel and adore Him: the Lord is His name.
slides.label: Verse 5

title: Of the Father's Love Begotten
author: Prudentius, tr. John M. Neale and Henry W. Baker

slides.text:
Of the Father's love begotten,
Ere the worlds began to be,
He is Alpha and Omega,
He the source, the ending He,
Of the things that are, that have been,
And that future years shall see,
Evermore and evermore!
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
He is here, whom seers in old time
Chanted of, while ages ran;
Whom the writings of the prophets
Promised since the world began;
Then foretold, now manifested,
To receive the praise of man,
Evermore and evermore!
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
O that ever-blessèd birthday,
When the virgin, full of grace,
Of the Holy Ghost incarnate
Bare the Savior of our race;
And that Child, the world's Redeemer,
First displayed His sacred face,
Evermore and evermore!
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Praise Him, O ye Heav'n of Heavens!
Praise Him, angels in the height!
Every power and every virtue
Sing praise of God aright;
Let no tongue of man be silent,
Let each heart and voice unite,
Evermore and evermore!
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Thee let age, and Thee let manhood,
Thee let choirs of infants sing;
Thee the matrons and the virgins,
And the children answering;
Let their modest song re-echo,
And their heart its praises bring,
Evermore and evermore!
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Laud and honor to the Father,
Laud and honor to the Son!
Laud and honor to the Spirit!
Ever Three, and ever One;
Consubstantial, co-eternal,
While unending ages run,
Evermore and evermore!
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
Once in royal David's city,
Stood a lowly cattle shed, 
Where a mother laid her baby
In a manger for His bed. 
Mary was that mother mild, 
Jesus Christ, her little child.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
He came down to earth from heaven, 
Who is God and Lord of all, 
And His shelter was a stable, 
And His cradle was a stall: 
With the poor and meek and lowly 
Lived on earth our Saviour holy.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
And through all His wondrous childhood 
He would honour and obey, 
Love and watch the lowly mother 
In whose gentle arms He lay. 
Christian children all should be 
Mild, obedient, good as He.
slides.label: Verse 3
Verse 4
Verse 5

slides.text:
Not in that poor lowly stable, 
With the oxen standing by, 
We shall see Him, but in heaven, 
Set at God’s right hand on high; 
When like stars His children crowned, 
All in white shall wait around.
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
Onward christian soldiers,
Marching as to war,
With the cross of Jesus 
Going on before! 
Christ, the royal Master, 
Leads against the foe; 
Forward into battle, 
See, His banners go!
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Onward, Christian soldiers, 
Marching as to war, 
With the cross of Jesus 
Going on before.
slides.label: Verse 2
Verse 3

slides.text:
Like a mighty army 
Moves the church of God: 
Brothers we are treading 
Where the saints have trod. 
We are not divided,
All one body we, 
One in hope and doctrine, 
One in charity.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Crowns and thrones may perish, 
Kingdoms rise and wane, 
But the church of Jesus 
Constant will remain; 
Gates of hell can never 
’Gainst that church prevail; 
We have Christ’s own promise, 
And that cannot fail:
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Onward, then, ye people! 
Join our happy throng; 
Blend with ours your voices 
In the triumph-song: 
Glory, laud, and honour 
Unto Christ the King! 
This through countless ages 
Men and angels sing:
slides.label: Verse 6

title: Open My Eyes That I May See
author: Clara H. Scott

slides.text:
Open my eyes, that I may see
Glimpses of truth Thou hast for me;
Place in my hands the wonderful key
That shall unclasp and set me free.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Silently now I wait for Thee,
Ready my God, Thy will to see,
Open my eyes, illumine me,
Spirit divine!
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Open my ears, that I may hear
Voices of truth Thou sendest clear;
And while the wave notes fall on my ear,
Everything false will disappear.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Silently now I wait for Thee,
Ready my God, Thy will to see,
Open my eyes, illumine me,
Spirit divine!
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Open my mouth, and let me bear,
Gladly the warm truth everywhere;
Open my heart and let me prepare
Love with Thy children thus to share.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Silently now I wait for Thee,
Ready my God, Thy will to see,
Open my eyes, illumine me,
Spirit divine!
slides.label: Chorus

title: Pass Me Not, O Gentle Savior
author: Fanny J. Crosby

slides.text:
Pass me not, O gentle Savior,
Hear my humble cry;
While on others Thou art calling,
Do not pass me by.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Savior, Savior,
Hear my humble cry;
While on others Thou art calling,
Do not pass me by.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Let me at Thy throne of mercy
Find a sweet relief,
Kneeling there in deep contrition;
Help my unbelief.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Savior, Savior,
Hear my humble cry;
While on others Thou art calling,
Do not pass me by.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Trusting only in Thy merit,
Would I seek Thy face;
Heal my wounded, broken spirit,
Save me by Thy grace.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Savior, Savior,
Hear my humble cry;
While on others Thou art calling,
Do not pass me by.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Thou the Spring of all my comfort,
More than life to me,
Whom have I on earth beside Thee?
Whom in Heav'n but Thee?
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Savior, Savior,
Hear my humble cry;
While on others Thou art calling,
Do not pass me by.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Peace, perfect peace, in this dark world of sin?
The blood of Jesus whispers peace within.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Peace, perfect peace, by thronging duties pressed?
To do the will of Jesus, this is rest.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Peace, perfect peace, with sorrows surging round?
In Jesus’ presence nought but calm is found.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Peace, perfect peace, with loved ones far away?
In Jesus’ keeping we are safe, and they.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Peace, perfect peace, our future all unknown?
Jesus we know, and He is on the throne.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Peace, perfect peace, death shadowing us and ours?
Jesus has vanquished death and all its powers.
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
It is enough: earth’s struggles soon shall cease,
And Jesus calls us to heaven’s perfect peace.
slides.label: Verse 7

title: Praise God, from Whom All Blessings Flow
author: Thomas Ken

slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Praise Him, Praise Him! Jesus our blessed redeemer;
Sing, O earth, His wonderful love proclaim! 
Hail Him, hail Him! highest archangels in glory, 
Strength and honour give to His holy name. 
Like a shepherd, Jesus will guard His children, 
In His arms He carries them all day long; 
O ye saints that dwell in the mountains of Zion, 
Praise Him! praise Him! ever in joyful song.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Praise Him, praise Him! Jesus, our blessed Redeemer; 
For our sins He suffered and bled and died. 
He, our Rock, our hope of eternal salvation, 
Hail Him, hail Him! Jesus the Crucified. 
Loving Saviour, meekly enduring sorrow, 
Crowned with thorns that cruelly pierced His brow; 
Once for us rejected, despised, and forsaken, 
Prince of glory, ever triumphant now.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Praise Him, praise Him! Jesus, our blessed Redeemer; 
Heavenly portals loud with hosannas ring! 
Jesus, Saviour, reigneth for ever and ever, 
Crown Him, crown Him! Prophet and Priest and King! 
Death is vanquished, tell it with joy, ye faithful! 
Where is now thy victory, boasting grave?
