Jesus lives, no longer thy portals are cheerless; 
Jesus lives, the mighty and strong to save.
slides.label: Verse 3

title: Praise My Soul King of Heaven
author: Henry Francis Lyte

slides.text:
Praise, my soul, the King of heaven;
To His feet thy tribute bring. 
Ransomed, healed, restored, forgiven, 
Who like thee His praise should sing? 
Praise Him! Praise Him! 
Praise Him! Praise Him! 
Praise the everlasting King!
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Praise Him for His grace and favour 
To our fathers in distress; 
Praise Him, still the same forever, 
Slow to chide, and swift to bless. 
Praise Him! Praise Him! 
Praise Him! Praise Him! 
Glorious in His faithfulness.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Father-like, He tends and spares us; 
Well our feeble frame He knows; 
In His hands He gently bears us, 
Rescues us from all our foes. 
Praise Him! Praise Him! 
Praise Him! Praise Him! 
Widely as His mercy flows.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Angels in the height, adore Him; 
Ye behold Him face to face; 
Sun and moon, bow down before Him, 
Dwellers all in time and space. 
Praise Him! Praise Him! 
Praise Him! Praise Him! 
Praise with us the God of grace!
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Praise to the Lord, the Almighty, the King of creation!
O my soul, praise Him, for He is thy health and salvation!
All ye who hear,
Brothers and sisters, draw near,
Praise Him in glad adoration.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Praise to the Lord, who doth prosper thy work and defend thee;
Surely His goodness and mercy here daily attend thee:
Ponder anew
What the Almighty can do,
Who with His love doth befriend thee.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Praise to the Lord, who doth nourish thy life and restore thee,
Fitting thee well for the tasks that are ever before thee,
Then to thy need
He like a mother doth speed,
Spreading the wings of grace o’er thee.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Praise to the Lord, who when tempests their warfare are waging,
Who, when the elements madly around thee are raging,
Biddeth them cease,
Turneth their fury to peace,
Whirlwinds and waters assuaging.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Praise to the Lord, who, when darkness of sin is abounding,
Who, when the godless do triumph, all virtue confounding,
Sheddeth His light,
Chaseth the horrors of night,
Saints with His mercy surrounding.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Praise to the Lord! O let all that is in me adore Him!
All that hath life and breath, come now with praises before Him!
Let the Amen
Sound from His people again:
Gladly for aye we adore Him.
slides.label: Verse 6

title: Praise to the Holiest in the Height
author: John H. Newman

slides.text:
Praise to the holiest in the height,
And in the depth be praise; 
In all His words most wonderful, 
Most sure in all His ways.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
O loving wisdom of our God! 
When all was sin and shame, 
A second Adam to the fight 
And to the rescue came.
O wisest love! that flesh and blood, 
Which did in Adam fail, 
Should strive afresh against the foe, 
Should strive and should prevail;
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
And that a higher gift than grace 
Should flesh and blood refine,
God’s presence and His very self, 
And essence all-divine.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
O generous love! that He, who smote 
In Man for man the foe, 
The double agony in Man 
For man should undergo;
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
And in the garden secretly, 
And on the cross on high, 
Should teach His brethren, and inspire 
To suffer and to die.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Praise to the Holiest in the height,
And to the depth be praise;
In all His words most wonderful,
Most sure in all His ways.
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
Rejoice, the Lord is King!
Your Lord and King adore; 
Mortals, give thanks, and sing, 
And triumph ever more:
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice; 
Rejoice! Again I say: rejoice!
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Jesus the Saviour reigns, 
The God of truth and love;
When He had purged our stains, 
He took His seat above:
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
His kingdom cannot fail, 
He rules o’er earth and heaven; 
The keys of death and hell 
Are to our Jesus given:
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
He sits at God’s right hand 
Till all His foes submit, 
And bow to His command, 
And fall beneath His feet:
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Rejoice in glorious hope; 
Jesus the Judge shall come, 
And take His servants up 
To their eternal home:
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
We soon shall hear the archangel’s voice;
The trump of God shall sound: rejoice!
slides.label: Verse 7
Verse 1

slides.text:
Rejoice, rejoice, rejoice,
Give thanks and sing.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Bright youth and snow crowned age,
Strong men and maidens meek,
Raise high your free, exultant song,
God's wondrous praises speak.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Rejoice, rejoice, rejoice,
Give thanks and sing.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Yes onward, onward still
With hymn, and chant and song,
Through gate, and porch and columned aisle,
The hallowed pathways throng.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Rejoice, rejoice, rejoice,
Give thanks and sing.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
With all the angel choirs,
With all the saints of earth,
Pour out the strains of joy and bliss,
True rapture, noblest mirth.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Rejoice, rejoice, rejoice,
Give thanks and sing.
slides.label: Chorus
Verse 5

slides.text:
Rejoice, rejoice, rejoice,
Give thanks and sing.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
With voice as full and strong
As ocean's surging praise,
Send forth the hymns our fathers loved,
The psalms of ancient days.
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
Rejoice, rejoice, rejoice,
Give thanks and sing.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Yes, on through life's long path,
Still chanting as ye go;
From youth to age, by night and day,
In gladness and in woe.
slides.label: Verse 7

slides.text:
Rejoice, rejoice, rejoice,
Give thanks and sing.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Still lift your standard high,
Still march in firm array,
As warriors through the darkness toil,
Till dawns the golden day.
slides.label: Verse 8

slides.text:
Rejoice, rejoice, rejoice,
Give thanks and sing.
slides.label: Chorus
Verse 9

slides.text:
Rejoice, rejoice, rejoice,
Give thanks and sing.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Then on, ye pure in heart!
Rejoice, give thanks and sing!
Your glorious banner wave on high,
The cross of Christ your king.
slides.label: Verse 10

slides.text:
Rejoice, rejoice, rejoice,
Give thanks and sing.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Praise Him who reigns on high,
The Lord whom we adore,
The Father, Son and Holy Ghost,
One God forevermore.
slides.label: Verse 11

slides.text:
Rejoice, rejoice, rejoice,
Give thanks and sing.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Rescue the perishing, care for the dying,
Snatch them in pity from sin and the grave;
Weep o'er the erring one, lift up the fallen,
Tell them of Jesus, the mighty to save.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Rescue the perishing, care for the dying,
Jesus is merciful, Jesus will save.
slides.label: Chorus
Verse 2

slides.text:
Rescue the perishing, care for the dying,
Jesus is merciful, Jesus will save.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Down in the human heart, crushed by the tempter,
Feelings lie buried that grace can restore;
Touched by a loving heart, wakened by kindness,
Chords that were broken will vibrate once more.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Rescue the perishing, care for the dying,
Jesus is merciful, Jesus will save.
slides.label: Chorus
Verse 4

slides.text:
Rescue the perishing, care for the dying,
Jesus is merciful, Jesus will save.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
We praise Thee, O God!
For the Son of Thy love,
For Jesus who died,
And is now gone above.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Hallelujah! Thine the glory.
Hallelujah! Amen.
Hallelujah! Thine the glory.
Revive us again.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
We praise Thee, O God!
For Thy Spirit of light,
Who hath shown us our Savior,
And scattered our night.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Hallelujah! Thine the glory.
Hallelujah! Amen.
Hallelujah! Thine the glory.
Revive us again.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
All glory and praise
To the Lamb that was slain,
Who hath borne all our sins,
And hath cleansed every stain.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Hallelujah! Thine the glory.
Hallelujah! Amen.
Hallelujah! Thine the glory.
Revive us again.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
All glory and praise
To the God of all grace,
Who hast bought us, and sought us,
And guided our ways.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Hallelujah! Thine the glory.
Hallelujah! Amen.
Hallelujah! Thine the glory.
Revive us again.
slides.label: Chorus
Verse 5

slides.text:
Hallelujah! Thine the glory.
Hallelujah! Amen.
Hallelujah! Thine the glory.
Revive us again.
slides.label: Chorus

title: Ride on Ride on in Majesty
author: H. H. Milman

slides.text:
Ride on, ride on in majesty!
In lowly pomp ride on to die! 
O Christ, Thy triumphs now begin 
O’er captive death and conquered sin.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Ride on, ride on in majesty! 
Hark all the tribes ‘hosanna’ cry; 
Thine humble beast pursues his road 
With palms and scattered garments strowed.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Ride on, ride on in majesty! 
Thy last and fiercest strife is nigh; 
The Father on His sapphire throne 
Expects His own anointed Son.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Ride on, ride on in majesty! 
In lowly pomp ride on to die! 
Bow Thy meek head to mortal pain, 
Then take, O God, Thy power, and reign!
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Rock of ages, cleft for me, 
Let me hide myself in Thee; 
Let the water and the blood, 
From Thy riven side which flowed, 
Be of sin the double cure, 
Cleanse me from its guilt and power.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Not the labour of my hands 
Can fulfil Thy law’s demands; 
Could my zeal no respite know, 
Could my tears forever flow, 
All for sin could not atone: 
Thou must save, and Thou alone.
slides.label: Verse 2
Verse 3

slides.text:
While I draw this fleeting breath, 
When mine eyes shall close in death, 
When I soar to worlds unknown, 
See Thee on Thy judgement throne, 
Rock of ages, cleft for me, 
Let me hide myself in Thee.
slides.label: Verse 4

title: Savior, Like a Shepherd Lead Us
author: Dorothy A. Thrupp

slides.text:
Savior, like a shepherd lead us,
Much we need Thy tender care;
In Thy pleasant pastures feed us,
For our use Thy folds prepare.
Blessèd Jesus, blessèd Jesus!
Thou hast bought us, Thine we are.
Blessèd Jesus, blessèd Jesus!
Thou hast bought us, Thine we are.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
We are Thine, Thou dost befriend us,
Be the guardian of our way;
Keep Thy flock, from sin defend us,
Seek us when we go astray.
Blessèd Jesus, blessèd Jesus!
Hear, O hear us when we pray.
Blessèd Jesus, blessèd Jesus!
Hear, O hear us when we pray.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Thou hast promised to receive us,
Poor and sinful though we be;
Thou hast mercy to relieve us,
Grace to cleanse and power to free.
Blessèd Jesus, blessèd Jesus!
We will early turn to Thee.
Blessèd Jesus, blessèd Jesus!
We will early turn to Thee.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Early let us seek Thy favor,
Early let us do Thy will;
Blessèd Lord and only Savior,
With Thy love our bosoms fill.
Blessèd Jesus, blessèd Jesus!
Thou hast loved us, love us still.
Blessèd Jesus, blessèd Jesus!
Thou hast loved us, love us still.
slides.label: Verse 4

title: Savior, More Than Life to Me
author: Fanny J. Crosby

slides.text:
Savior, more than life to me,
I am clinging, clinging, close to Thee;
Let Thy precious blood applied,
Keep me ever, ever near Thy side.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Every day, every hour,
Let me feel Thy cleansing power;
May Thy tender love to me
Bind me closer, closer, Lord to Thee.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Through this changing world below,
Lead me gently, gently as I go;
Trusting Thee, I cannot stray,
I can never, never lose my way.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Every day, every hour,
Let me feel Thy cleansing power;
May Thy tender love to me
Bind me closer, closer, Lord to Thee.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Let me love Thee more and more,
Till this fleeting, fleeting life is o'er;
Till my soul is lost in love,
In a brighter, brighter world above.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Every day, every hour,
Let me feel Thy cleansing power;
May Thy tender love to me
Bind me closer, closer, Lord to Thee.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
See, amid the winter's snow,
Born for us on earth below, 
See, the Lamb of God appears, 
Promised from eternal years.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Hail, thou ever-blessed morn! 
Hail, redemption’s happy dawn! 
Sing through all Jerusalem:
Christ is born in Bethlehem!
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Lo, within a manger lies
He who built the starry skies,
He who throned in height sublime
Sits amid the cherubim.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Say, ye holy shepherds, say, 
What your joyful news today; 
Wherefore have ye left your sheep 
On the lonely mountain steep?
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
‘As we watched at dead of night, 
Lo, we saw a wondrous light: 
Angels singing, “Peace on earth” 
Told us of the Saviour’s birth.’
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Sacred Infant, all divine, 
What a tender love was Thine, 
Thus to come from highest bliss 
Down to such a world as this!
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
Teach, O teach us, holy Child, 
By Thy face so meek and mild, 
Teach us to resemble Thee 
In Thy sweet humility.
slides.label: Verse 7

title: Shall We Gather at the River
author: Robert Lowry

slides.text:
Shall we gather at the river,
Where bright angel feet have trod,
With its crystal tide forever
Flowing by the throne of God?
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Yes, we'll gather at the river,
The beautiful, the beautiful river;
Gather with the saints at the river
That flows by the throne of God.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
On the margin of the river,
Washing up its silver spray,
We will talk and worship ever,
All the happy golden day.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Yes, we'll gather at the river,
The beautiful, the beautiful river;
Gather with the saints at the river
That flows by the throne of God.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Ere we reach the shining river,
Lay we every burden down;
Grace our spirits will deliver,
And provide a robe and crown.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Yes, we'll gather at the river,
The beautiful, the beautiful river;
Gather with the saints at the river
That flows by the throne of God.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
At the smiling of the river,
Mirror of the Savior's face,
Saints, whom death will never sever,
Lift their songs of saving grace.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Yes, we'll gather at the river,
The beautiful, the beautiful river;
Gather with the saints at the river
That flows by the throne of God.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Soon we'll reach the silver river,
Soon our pilgrimage will cease;
Soon our happy hearts will quiver
With the melody of peace.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Yes, we'll gather at the river,
The beautiful, the beautiful river;
Gather with the saints at the river
That flows by the throne of God.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Silent night, holy night! 
Sleeps the world; hid from sight, 
Mary and Joseph in stable bare 
Watch o’er the Child beloved and fair, 
Sleeping in heavenly rest, 
Sleeping in heavenly rest.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Silent night, holy night! 
Shepherds first saw the light, 
Heard resounding clear and long, 
Far and near, the angel-song: 
‘Christ the Redeemer is here, 
Christ the Redeemer is here.’
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Silent night, holy night! 
Son of God, O how bright 
Love is smiling from Thy face! 
Strikes for us now the hour of grace, 
Saviour, since Thou art born, 
Saviour, since Thou art born.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Softly and tenderly Jesus is calling,
Calling for you and for me;
See, on the portals He's waiting and watching,
Watching for you and for me.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Come home, come home,
You who are weary, come home;
Earnestly, tenderly, Jesus is calling,
Calling, O sinner, come home!
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Why should we tarry when Jesus is pleading,
Pleading for you and for me?
Why should we linger and heed not His mercies,
Mercies for you and for me?
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Come home, come home,
You who are weary, come home;
Earnestly, tenderly, Jesus is calling,
Calling, O sinner, come home!
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Time is now fleeting, the moments are passing,
Passing from you and from me;
Shadows are gathering, deathbeds are coming,
Coming for you and for me.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Come home, come home,
You who are weary, come home;
Earnestly, tenderly, Jesus is calling,
Calling, O sinner, come home!
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
O for the wonderful love He has promised,
Promised for you and for me!
Though we have sinned,
He has mercy and pardon,
Pardon for you and for me.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Come home, come home,
You who are weary, come home;
Earnestly, tenderly, Jesus is calling,
Calling, O sinner, come home!
slides.label: Chorus
Verse 1

slides.text:
Strong in the Lord of hosts, 
And in His mighty power; 
Who in the strength of Jesus trusts 
Is more than conqueror.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Stand, then, in His great might,
With all His strength endued;
And take, to arm you for the fight,
The panoply of God.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Leave no unguarded place, 
No weakness of the soul; 
Take every virtue, every grace, 
And fortify the whole.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
From strength to strength go on, 
Wrestle and fight and pray; 
Tread all the powers of darkness down, 
And win the well-fought day.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
That having all things done, 
And all your conflicts past, 
Ye may o’ercome, through Christ alone, 
And stand complete at last.
slides.label: Verse 6

title: Stand Up, Stand Up for Jesus
author: George Duffield, Jr.

slides.text:
Stand up, stand up for Jesus,
Ye soldiers of the cross;
Lift high His royal banner,
It must not suffer loss.
From victory unto victory
His army shall He lead,
Till every foe is vanquished,
And Christ is Lord indeed.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Stand up, stand up for Jesus,
The solemn watchword hear;
If while ye sleep He suffers,
Away with shame and fear;
Where'er ye meet with evil,
Within you or without,
Charge for the God of battles,
And put the foe to rout.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Stand up, stand up for Jesus,
The trumpet call obey;
Forth to the mighty conflict,
In this His glorious day.
Ye that are brave now serve Him
Against unnumbered foes;
Let courage rise with danger,
And strength to strength oppose.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Stand up, stand up for Jesus,
Stand in His strength alone;
The arm of flesh will fail you,
Ye dare not trust your own.
Put on the Gospel armor,
Each piece put on with prayer;
Where duty calls or danger,
Be never wanting there.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Stand up, stand up for Jesus,
Each soldier to his post,
Close up the broken column,
And shout through all the host:
Make good the loss so heavy,
In those that still remain,
And prove to all around you
That death itself is gain.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Stand up, stand up for Jesus,
The strife will not be long;
This day the noise of battle,
The next the victor's song.
To him who overcometh
A crown of life shall be;
They with the King of Glory
Shall reign eternally.
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
Standing on the promises of Christ my king,
Through eternal ages let His praises ring,
Glory in the highest, I will shout and sing,
Standing on the promises of God.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Standing, standing,
Standing on the promises of God my Savior;
Standing, standing,
I'm standing on the promises of God.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Standing on the promises that cannot fail,
When the howling storms of doubt and fear assail,
By the living Word of God I shall prevail,
Standing on the promises of God.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Standing, standing,
Standing on the promises of God my Savior;
Standing, standing,
I'm standing on the promises of God.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Standing on the promises I now can see
Perfect, present cleansing in the blood for me;
Standing in the liberty where Christ makes free,
Standing on the promises of God.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Standing, standing,
Standing on the promises of God my Savior;
Standing, standing,
I'm standing on the promises of God.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Standing on the promises of Christ the Lord,
Bound to Him eternally by love's strong cord,
Overcoming daily with the Spirit's sword,
Standing on the promises of God.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Standing, standing,
Standing on the promises of God my Savior;
Standing, standing,
I'm standing on the promises of God.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Standing on the promises I cannot fall,
Listening every moment to the Spirit's call
Resting in my Savior as my all in all,
Standing on the promises of God.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Standing, standing,
Standing on the promises of God my Savior;
Standing, standing,
I'm standing on the promises of God.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Sweet hour of prayer! sweet hour of prayer!
That calls me from a world of care,
And bids me at my Father's throne
Make all my wants and wishes known.
In seasons of distress and grief,
My soul has often found relief
And oft escaped the tempter's snare
By thy return, sweet hour of prayer!
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Sweet hour of prayer! sweet hour of prayer!
The joys I feel, the bliss I share,
Of those whose anxious spirits burn
With strong desires for thy return!
With such I hasten to the place
Where God my Savior shows His face,
And gladly take my station there,
And wait for thee, sweet hour of prayer!
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Sweet hour of prayer! sweet hour of prayer!
Thy wings shall my petition bear
To Him whose truth and faithfulness
Engage the waiting soul to bless.
And since He bids me seek His face,
Believe His Word and trust His grace,
I'll cast on Him my every care,
And wait for thee, sweet hour of prayer!
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Sweet hour of prayer! sweet hour of prayer!
May I thy consolation share,
Till, from Mount Pisgah's lofty height,
I view my home and take my flight:
This robe of flesh I'll drop and rise
To seize the everlasting prize;
And shout, while passing through the air,
Farewell, farewell, sweet hour of prayer!
slides.label: Verse 4

title: Take my Life and Let it Be
author: Frances Ridley Havergal

slides.text:
Take my life, and let it be
Consecrated, Lord, to Thee; 
Take my moments and my days, 
Let them flow in ceaseless praise.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Take my hands, and let them move 
At the impulse of Thy love; 
Take my feet, and let them be 
Swift and beautiful for Thee.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Take my voice, and let me sing 
Always, only, for my King; 
Take my lips, and let them be 
Filled with messages from Thee.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Take my silver and my gold, 
Not a mite would I withhold; 
Take my intellect, and use 
Every power as Thou shalt choose.
slides.label: Verse 4
Verse 5

slides.text:
Take my love; my Lord, I pour 
At Thy feet its treasure store: 
Take myself, and I will be 
Ever, only, all for Thee.
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
Take time to be holy,
Speak oft with thy Lord;
Abide in Him always,
And feed on His Word.
Make friends of God's children,
Help those who are weak,
Forgetting in nothing
His blessing to seek.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Take time to be holy,
The world rushes on;
Spend much time in secret,
With Jesus alone.
By looking to Jesus,
Like Him thou shalt be;
Thy friends in thy conduct
His likeness shall see.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Take time to be holy,
Let Him be thy guide;
And run not before Him,
Whatever betide.
In joy or in sorrow,
Still follow the Lord,
And, looking to Jesus,
Still trust in His Word.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Take time to be holy,
Be calm in thy soul,
Each thought and each motive
Beneath His control.
Thus led by His Spirit
To fountains of love,
Thou soon shalt be fitted
For service above.
slides.label: Verse 4

title: Tell Me the Old, Old Story
author: A. Katherine Hankey

slides.text:
Tell me the old, old story
Of unseen things above,
Of Jesus and His glory,
Of Jesus and His love.
Tell me the story simply,
As to a little child,
For I am weak and weary,
And helpless and defiled.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story,
Of Jesus and His love.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Tell me the story slowly,
That I may take it in,
That wonderful redemption,
God's remedy for sin.
Tell me the story often,
For I forget so soon;
The early dew of morning
Has passed away at noon.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story,
Of Jesus and His love.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Tell me the story softly,
With earnest tones and grave;
Remember I'm the sinner
Whom Jesus came to save.
Tell me the story always,
If you would really be,
In any time of trouble,
A comforter to me.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story,
Of Jesus and His love.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Tell me the same old story
When you have cause to fear
That this world's empty glory
Is costing me too dear.
Yes, and when that world's glory
Is dawning on my soul,
Tell me the old, old story:
Christ Jesus makes thee whole.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story,
Tell me the old, old story,
Of Jesus and His love.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
The church's one foundation
Is Jesus Christ, her Lord;
She is His new creation
By water and the word;
From heaven He came and sought her
To be His holy bride,
With His own blood He bought her,
And for her life He died.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Elect from every nation,
Yet one o’er all the earth,
Her charter of salvation—
One Lord, one faith, one birth;
One holy name she blesses,
Partakes one holy food,
And to one hope she presses
With every grace endued.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Though with a scornful wonder
Men see her sore oppressed,
By schisms rent asunder,
By heresies distressed,
Yet saints their watch are keeping,
Their cry goes up, ‘How long?’
And soon the night of weeping
Shall be the morn of song.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
’Mid toil, and tribulation,
And tumult of her war,
She waits the consummation
Of peace forever more;
Till with the vision glorious
Her longing eyes are blessed,
And the great church victorious
Shall be the church at rest.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Yet she on earth hath union
With God the Three in One,
And mystic sweet communion
With those whose rest is won:
O happy ones and holy!
Lord, give us grace that we,
Like them, the meek and lowly,
On high may dwell with Thee.
slides.label: Verse 5

title: The Day of Resurrection
author: John of Damascus, tr. John M. Neale

slides.text:
The day of resurrection!
Earth, tell it out abroad;
The Passover of gladness,
The Passover of God.
From death to life eternal,
From earth unto the sky,
Our Christ hath brought us over,
With hymns of victory.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Our hearts be pure from evil,
That we may see aright
The Lord in rays eternal
Of resurrection light;
And listening to His accents,
May hear, so calm and plain,
His own All hail! and, hearing,
May raise the victor strain.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Now let the heav'ns be joyful!
Let earth the song begin!
Let all the world keep triumph,
And everything therein!
Let all things seen and unseen
Their notes in gladness blend,
For Christ the Lord hath risen,
Our joy that hath no end.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
The day Thou gavest, Lord, is ended,
The darkness falls at Thy behest;
To Thee our morning hymns ascended,
Thy praise shall sanctify our rest.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
We thank Thee that Thy church unsleeping,
While earth rolls onward into light,
Through all the world her watch is keeping,
And rests not now by day or night.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
As o’er each continent and island
The dawn leads on another day,
The voice of prayer is never silent,
Nor dies the strain of praise away.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
The sun that bids us rest is waking
Our brethren ’neath the western sky,
And hour by hour fresh lips are making
Thy wondrous doings heard on high.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
So be it, Lord! Thy throne shall never,
Like earth’s proud empires, pass away;
Thy kingdom stands, and grows for ever,
Till all Thy creatures own Thy sway.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
The first nowell the angel did say
Was to certain poor shepherds in fields as they lay;
In fields where they lay keeping their sheep,
On a cold winter’s night that was so deep.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Nowell, nowell, nowell, nowell,
Born is the King of Israel!
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
They looked up and saw a star
Shining in the east, beyond them far,
And to the earth it gave great light,
And so it continued both day and night.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
And by the light of that same star
Three wise men came from country far;
To seek for a King was their intent,
And to follow the star wherever it went.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
This star drew nigh to the north-west;
Over Bethlehem it took its rest,
And there it did both stop and stay
Right over the place where Jesus lay.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Then entered in those wise men three
Full reverently upon their knee,
And offered there in His presence
Their gold, and myrrh, and frankincense.
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
Then let us all with one accord
Sing praises to our heavenly Lord,
That hath made heaven and earth of nought,
And with His blood mankind hath bought.
slides.label: Verse 7

slides.text:
The God of Abraham praise,
Who reigns enthroned above,
Ancient of everlasting days, and God of love.
Jehovah! Great I AM!
By earth and heaven confessed;
I bow and bless the sacred name forever blessed.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
The God of Abraham praise,
At whose supreme command
From earth I rise, and seek the joys at His right hand.
I all on earth forsake --
Its wisdom, fame, and power --
And Him my only portion make, my shield and tower.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
The God of Abraham praise,
Whose all-sufficient grace
Shall guide me all my happy days in all my ways.
He calls a worm His friend,
He calls Himself my God;
And He shall save me to the end through Jesu’s blood.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
He by Himself hath sworn,
I on His oath depend:
I shall, on eagles’ wings upborne, to heaven ascend;
I shall behold His face,
I shall His power adore,
And sing the wonders of His grace forever more.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
There dwells the Lord our King,
The Lord our Righteousness,
Triumphant o’er the world and sin, the Prince of Peace;
On Zion’s sacred height
His kingdom still maintains,
And glorious with His saints in light forever reigns.
slides.label: Verse 5
Verse 6

slides.text:
Before the Saviour’s face
The ransomed nations bow;
O’erwhelmed at His almighty grace, forever new:
He shows His prints of love,
They kindle to a flame,
And sound through all the worlds above the slaughtered Lamb.
slides.label: Verse 7

slides.text:
The whole triumphant host
Give thanks to God on high;
Hail, Father, Son, and Holy Ghost! They ever cry.
Hail, Abraham’s God, and mine!
I join the heavenly lays;  All might and majesty 
are Thine, and endless praise.
slides.label: Verse 8

title: The Head That Once Was Crowned
author: Thomas Kelly

slides.text:
The head that once was crowned
Is crowned with glory now;
A royal diadem adorns
The mighty Victor’s brow.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
The highest place that heaven affords
Is His by sovereign right,
The King of kings, the Lord of lords,
And heaven’s eternal light.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
The joy of all who dwell above,
The joy of all below,
To whom He manifests His love,
And grants His name to know.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
To them the cross, with all its shame,
With all its grace, is given;
Their name an everlasting name,
Their joy the joy of heaven.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
They suffer with their Lord below,
They reign with Him above;
Their profit and their joy to know
The mystery of His love.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
The cross He bore is life and health,
Though shame and death to Him;
His people’s hope, His people’s wealth,
Their everlasting theme.
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
The King of Love my Shepherd is,
Whose goodness faileth never;
I nothing lack if I am His
And He is mine forever.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Where streams of living water flow
My ransomed soul He leadeth,
And where the verdant pastures grow
With food celestial feedeth.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Perverse and foolish oft I strayed,
But yet in love He sought me,
And on His shoulder gently laid,
And home rejoicing brought me.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
!n death’s dark vale I fear no ill
With Thee, dear Lord, beside me;
Thy rod and staff my comfort still,
Thy cross before to guide me.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Thou spread’st a table in my sight;
Thy unction grace bestoweth:
And O what transport of delight
From Thy pure chalice floweth!
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
And so through all the length of days
Thy goodness faileth never;
Good Shepherd, may I sing Thy praise
Within Thy house forever.
slides.label: Verse 6

title: There Is a Fountain Filled with Blood
author: William Cowper

slides.text:
There is a fountain filled with blood
Drawn from Emmanuel's veins;
And sinners plunged beneath that flood
Lose all their guilty stains.
Lose all their guilty stains,
Lose all their guilty stains;
And sinners plunged beneath that flood
Lose all their guilty stains.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
The dying thief rejoiced to see
That fountain in his day;
And there have I, though vile as he,
Washed all my sins away.
Washed all my sins away,
Washed all my sins away;
And there have I, though vile as he,
Washed all my sins away.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Dear dying Lamb, Thy precious blood
Shall never lose its power
Till all the ransomed church of God
Be saved, to sin no more.
Be saved, to sin no more,
Be saved, to sin no more;
Till all the ransomed church of God
Be saved, to sin no more.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
E'er since, by faith, I saw the stream
Thy flowing wounds supply,
Redeeming love has been my theme,
And shall be till I die.
And shall be till I die,
And shall be till I die;
Redeeming love has been my theme,
And shall be till I die.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Then in a nobler, sweeter song,
I'll sing Thy power to save,
When this poor lisping, stammering tongue
Lies silent in the grave.
Lies silent in the grave,
Lies silent in the grave;
When this poor lisping, stammering tongue
Lies silent in the grave.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Lord, I believe Thou hast prepared,
Unworthy though I be,
For me a blood bought free reward,
A golden harp for me!
A golden harp for me,
A golden harp for me;
For me a blood bought free reward,
A golden harp for me!
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
'Tis strung and tuned for endless years,
And formed by power divine,
To sound in God the Father's ears
No other name but Thine;
No other name but Thine,
No other name but Thine;
To sound in God the Father's ears
No other name but Thine.
slides.label: Verse 7

title: There is a Green Hill Far Away
author: Cecil F. Alexander

slides.text:
There is a green hill far away,
Outside a city wall,
Where the dear Lord was crucified,
Who died to save us all.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
We may not know, we cannot tell,
What pains He had to bear;
But we believe it was for us
He hung and suffered there.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
He died that we might be forgiven,
He died to make us good,
That we might go at last to heaven,
Saved by His precious blood.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
There was no other good enough
To pay the price of sin;
He only could unlock the gate
Of heaven, and let us in.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
O dearly, dearly has He loved!
And we must love Him too,
And trust in His redeeming blood,
And try His works to do.
slides.label: Verse 5

title: There is a Name I Love to Hear
author: Frederick Whitfield

slides.text:
There is a name I love to hear,
I love to speak its worth;
It sounds like music in my ear,
The sweetest name on earth.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
O, how I love the Saviour’s name,
O, how I love the Saviour’s name,
O, how I love the Saviour’s name,
The sweetest name on earth.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
It tells me of a Saviour’s love,
Who died to set me free;
It tells me of His precious blood,
The sinner’s perfect plea.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
It tells of One whose loving heart
Can feel my deepest woe;
Who in my sorrow bears a part
That none can bear below.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
It bids my trembling heart rejoice,
It dries each rising tear;
It tells me in a still, small voice
To trust and never fear.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Jesus, the name I love so well,
The name I love to hear!
No saint on earth its worth can tell,
No heart conceive how dear!
slides.label: Verse 6

title: There Is Power in the Blood
author: Lewis E. Jones

slides.text:
Would you be free from the burden of sin?
There's power in the blood, power in the blood;
Would you o'er evil a victory win?
There's wonderful power in the blood.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
There is power, power, wonder working power
In the blood of the Lamb;
There is power, power, wonder working power
In the precious blood of the Lamb.
slides.label: Chorus
Verse 2

slides.text:
There is power, power, wonder working power
In the blood of the Lamb;
There is power, power, wonder working power
In the precious blood of the Lamb.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Would you be whiter, much whiter than snow?
There's power in the blood, power in the blood;
Sin stains are lost in its life giving flow.
There's wonderful power in the blood.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
There is power, power, wonder working power
In the blood of the Lamb;
There is power, power, wonder working power
In the precious blood of the Lamb.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Would you do service for Jesus your king?
There's power in the blood, power in the blood;
Would you live daily His praises to sing?
There's wonderful power in the blood.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
There is power, power, wonder working power
In the blood of the Lamb;
There is power, power, wonder working power
In the precious blood of the Lamb.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Thine be the glory,
Risen, conquering Son;
Endless is the victory
Thou o’er death hast won.
Angels in bright raiment
Rolled the stone away,
Kept the folded grave-clothes
Where Thy body lay.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Thine be the glory,
Risen, conquering Son;
Endless is the victory
Thou o’er death hast won!
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Lo, Jesus meets us,
Risen from the tomb!
Lovingly He greets us,
Scatters fear and gloom.
Let the church with gladness
Hymns of triumph sing,
For her Lord now liveth,
Death hath lost its sting.
slides.label: Verse 3
Verse 4

slides.text:
Thou didst Leave Thy throne and Thy kingly crown,
When Thou camest to earth for me;
But in Bethlehem’s home there was found no room
For Thy holy nativity:
O come to my heart, Lord Jesus!
There is room in my heart for Thee.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Heaven’s arches rang when the angels sang,
Proclaiming Thy royal degree;
But of lowly birth cam’st Thou, Lord, on earth,
And in great humility,
O come to my heart, Lord Jesus!
There is room in my heart for Thee.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
The foxes found rest, and the birds had their nest,
In the shade of the cedar tree;
But Thy couch was the sod, O Thou Son of God,
In the deserts of Galilee.
O come to my heart, Lord Jesus!
There is room in my heart for Thee.
Thou camest, O Lord, with the living word
That should set Thy children free;
But with mocking scorn, and with crown of thorn,
They bore Thee to Calvary.
O come to my heart, Lord Jesus!
Thy cross is my only plea.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
When heaven’s arches shall ring, and her choirs shall sing,
At Thy coming to victory,
Let Thy voice call me home, saying, ‘Yet there is room,
There is room at My side for thee.’
And my heart shall rejoice, Lord Jesus,
When Thou comest and callest for me.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Thou, whose almighty word
Chaos and darkness heard,
And took their flight;
Hear us, we humbly pray,
And where the gospel-day
Sheds not its glorious ray,
Let there be light!
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Thou who didst come to bring,
On Thy redeeming wing,
Healing and sight;
Health to the sick in mind,
Sight to the inly blind,
O now to all mankind
Let there be light!
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Spirit of truth and love,
Life-giving, holy Dove,
Speed forth Thy flight;
Move on the waters’ face,
Bearing the lamp of grace,
And in earth’s darkest place
Let there be light!
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Blessed and holy Three,
Glorious Trinity,
Wisdom, love, might;
Boundless as ocean’s tide
Rolling in fullest pride,
Through the world far and wide
Let there be light!
slides.label: Verse 4
Verse 1

slides.text:
Throw out the life line! Throw out the life line!
Someone is drifting away;
Throw out the life line! Throw out the life line!
Someone is sinking today.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Throw out the life line with hand quick and strong:
Why do you tarry, why linger so long?
See! he is sinking; oh, hasten today
And out with the life boat! away, then away!
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Throw out the life line! Throw out the life line!
Someone is drifting away;
Throw out the life line! Throw out the life line!
Someone is sinking today.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Throw out the life line to danger fraught men,
Sinking in anguish where you've never been;
Winds of temptation and billows of woe
Will soon hurl them out where the dark waters flow.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Throw out the life line! Throw out the life line!
Someone is drifting away;
Throw out the life line! Throw out the life line!
Someone is sinking today.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Soon will the season of rescue be o'er,
Soon will they drift to eternity's shore;
Haste, then, my brother, no time for delay,
But throw out the life line and save them today.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Throw out the life line! Throw out the life line!
Someone is drifting away;
Throw out the life line! Throw out the life line!
Someone is sinking today.
slides.label: Chorus
Verse 5

slides.text:
Throw out the life line! Throw out the life line!
Someone is drifting away;
Throw out the life line! Throw out the life line!
Someone is sinking today.
slides.label: Chorus
Verse 6

slides.text:
Throw out the life line! Throw out the life line!
Someone is drifting away;
Throw out the life line! Throw out the life line!
Someone is sinking today.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
This is the life line, oh, grasp it today!
See, you are recklessly drifting away;
Voices in warning, shout over the wave,
O grasp the strong life line, for Jesus can save.
slides.label: Verse 7

slides.text:
Throw out the life line! Throw out the life line!
Someone is drifting away;
Throw out the life line! Throw out the life line!
Someone is sinking today.
slides.label: Chorus

title: Thy Hand O God Has Guided
author: Edward Hayes Plumptre

slides.text:
Thy Hand, O God has guided
Thy flock, from age to age;
The wondrous tale is written,
Full clear on every page.
Our fathers owned Thy goodness,
And we their deeds record;
And both of this bear witness:
One Church, one Faith, one Lord.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Thy heralds brought glad tidings
To greatest as to least;
They bade them rise and hasten
To share the great King’s feast.
And this was all their teaching
In every deed and word;
To all alike proclaiming:
One Church, one Faith, one Lord.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Through many a day of darkness,
Through many a scene of strife,
The faithful few fought bravely
To guard the nation’s life.
Their gospel of redemption,
Sin pardoned, man restored,
Was all in this enfolded:
One Church, one Faith, one Lord.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Thy mercy will not fail us,
Nor leave Thy work undone;
With Thy right hand to help us,
The victory shall be won.
And then, by men and angels,
Thy name shall be adored,
And this shall be their anthem:
One Church, one Faith, one Lord.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
To God be the glory! great things He hath done!
So loved He the world that He gave us His Son,
Who yielded His life an atonement for sin,
And opened the life-gate that all may go in.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Praise the Lord! Praise the Lord!
Let the earth hear His voice!
Praise the Lord! Praise the Lord!
Let the people rejoice!
O come to the Father through Jesus the Son;
And give Him the glory, great things He hath done!
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
O perfect redemption, the purchase of blood!
To every believer the promise of God;
The vilest offender who truly believes,
That moment from Jesus a pardon receives.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Great things He hath taught us, great things He hath done,
And great our rejoicing through Jesus the Son:
But purer and higher and greater will be
Our wonder, our worship, when Jesus we see!
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
We plough the fields and scatter
The good seed on the land,
But it is fed and watered
By God’s almighty hand;
He sends the snow in winter,
The warmth to swell the grain,
The breezes and the sunshine,
And soft refreshing rain.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
All good gifts around us
Are sent from heaven above;
Then thank the Lord, O thank the Lord,
For all His love.
slides.label: Verse 2
Verse 3

slides.text:
We thank Thee, then, O Father,
For all things bright and good;
The seedtime and the harvest,
Our life, our health, our food.
No gifts have we to offer
For all Thy love imparts,
But that which Thou desirest,
Our humble, thankful hearts.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
We rest on Thee, our Shield and our Defender!
We go not forth alone against the foe;
Strong in Thy strength, safe in Thy keeping tender,
We rest on Thee and in Thy name we go.
Strong in Thy strength, safe in Thy keeping tender,
We rest on Thee, and in Thy name we go.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Yes, in Thy name, O Captain of salvation!
In Thy dear name, all other names above,
Jesus our Righteousness, our sure Foundation,
Our Prince of glory and our King of love.
Jesus our Righteousness, our sure Foundation,
Our Prince of glory and our King of love.
slides.label: Verse 2
Verse 3

slides.text:
We rest on Thee, our Shield and our Defender!
Thine is the battle, Thine shall be the praise;
When passing through the gates of pearly splendour,
Victors, we rest with Thee, through endless days.
When passing through the gates of pearly splendour,
Victors, we rest with Thee, through endless days.
slides.label: Verse 4

title: What a Friend we Have in Jesus
author: Joseph M. Scriven

slides.text:
What a friend we have in Jesus,
All our sins and griefs to bear!
What a privilege to carry
Everything to God in prayer!
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
O what peace we often forfeit!
O what needless pain we bear!
All because we do not carry
Everything to God in prayer.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Have we trials and temptations?
Is there trouble anywhere?
We should never be discouraged;
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Can we find a friend so faithful
Who will all our sorrows share?
Jesus knows our every weakness;
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Are we weak and heavy-laden,
Cumbered with a load of care?
Precious Saviour, still our refuge,
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Do thy friends despise, forsake thee?
Take it to the Lord in prayer;
In His arms He’ll take and shield thee,
Thou wilt find a solace there.
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
What child is this, who, laid to rest
On Mary’s lap is sleeping:
Whom angels greet with anthems sweet,
While shepherds watch are keeping?
This, this is Christ the King,
Whom shepherds guard and angels sing:
Haste, haste, to bring Him praise,
The babe, the Son of Mary.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Why lies He in such mean estate,
Where ox and ass are feeding?
Good Christians, fear, for sinners here
The silent Word is pleading.
Nails, spear shall pierce Him through,
The cross be borne for me, for you.
Hail, hail the Word made flesh,
The babe, the Son of Mary.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
So bring Him incense, gold and myrrh,
Come, peasant, king, to own Him;
The King of kings salvation brings,
Let loving hearts enthrone Him.
Raise, raise a song on high,
The virgin sings her lullaby.
Joy, joy for Christ is born,
The babe, the Son of Mary.
slides.label: Verse 3

title: When I survey the Wondrous Cross
author: Isaac Watts

slides.text:
When I survey the wonderous Cross,
On which the Prince of glory died,
My richest gain I count but loss,
And pour contempt on all my pride.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Forbid it, Lord, that I should boast,
Save in the death of Christ my God:
All the vain things that charm me most,
I sacrifice them to His blood.
See from His head, His hands, His feet,
Sorrow and love flow mingled down:
Did e’er such love and sorrow meet,
Or thorns compose so rich a crown?
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Were the whole realm of Nature mine,
That were an offering far too small;
Love so amazing, so divine,
Demands my soul, my life, my all!
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
When morning gilds the skies
My heart awaking cries:
‘May Jesus Christ be praised!’
Alike at work and prayer
To Jesus I repair:
‘May Jesus Christ be praised!’
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Does sadness fill my mind?
A solace here I find:
‘May Jesus Christ be praised!’
When evil thoughts molest,
With this I shield my breast:
‘May Jesus Christ be praised!’
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
To God, the Word, on high
The hosts of angels cry:
‘May Jesus Christ be praised!’
Let mortals, too, upraise
Their voice in hymns of praise:
‘May Jesus Christ be praised!’
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Let earth’s wide circle round
In joyful notes resound:
‘May Jesus Christ be praised!’
Let air, and sea, and sky,
From depth to height, reply:
‘May Jesus Christ be praised!’
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Be this while life is mine
My canticle divine:
‘May Jesus Christ be praised!’
Be this the eternal song,
Through all the ages long:
‘May Jesus Christ be praised!’
slides.label: Verse 5

title: When We Walk With the Lord
author: John Henry Sammis

slides.text:
When we walk with the Lord
In the light of His word,
What a glory He sheds on our way!
While we do His good will,
He abides with us still,
And with all who will trust and obey!
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Trust and obey!
For there’s no other way
To be happy in Jesus,
But to trust and obey.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Not a shadow can rise,
Not a cloud in the skies,
But His smile quickly drives it away;
Not a doubt nor a fear,
Not a sigh nor a tear,
Can abide while we trust and obey!
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Not a burden we bear,
Not a sorrow we share,
But our toil He doth richly repay:
Not a grief nor a loss,
Not a frown nor a cross,
But is blessed if we trust and obey!
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
But we never can prove
The delights of His love
Until all on the altar we lay;
For the favour He shows,
And the joy He bestows,
Are for those who will trust and obey.
slides.label: Verse 5
Verse 6

slides.text:
While shepherds watched
their flocks by night, 
All seated on the ground, 
The angel of the Lord came down 
And glory shone around.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
‘Fear not’ said he, for mighty dread 
Had seized their troubled mind; 
‘Glad tidings of great joy I bring 
To you and all mankind.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
‘To you in David’s town this day 
Is born of David’s line 
A Saviour, who is Christ the Lord, 
And this shall be the sign.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
‘The heavenly babe you there shall find 
To human view displayed, 
All meanly wrapped in swaddling bands, 
And in a manger laid.’
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Thus spake the seraph; and forthwith 
Appeared a shining throng 
Of angels, praising God, who thus 
Addressed their joyful song:
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
‘All glory be to God on high 
And on the earth be peace; 
Goodwill henceforth from heaven to men 
Begin and never cease.’
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
Who is He in yonder stall,
At whose feet the shepherds fall?
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
’Tis the Lord! 
O wondrous story! 
’Tis the Lord, the King of glory! 
At His feet we humbly fall. 
Crown Him! Crown Him, Lord of all!
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Who is He to whom they bring 
All the sick and sorrowing?
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Who is He that stands and weeps 
At the grave where Lazarus sleeps?
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Who is He on yonder tree 
Dies in pain and agony?
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Who is He who from the grave 
Comes to rescue, help, and save?
slides.label: Verse 6

slides.text:
Who is He who from His throne 
Sends the Spirit to His own?
slides.label: Verse 7

slides.text:
Who is He who comes again, 
Judge of angels and of men?
slides.label: Verse 8

title: Who is on the Lord's Side
author: Frances R. Havergal

slides.text:
Who is on the Lord's side?
Who will serve the King? 
Who will be His helpers 
Other lives to bring? 
Who will leave the world’s side? 
Who will face the foe? 
Who is on the Lord’s side? 
Who for Him will go? 
By Thy call of mercy, 
By Thy grace divine, 
We are on the Lord’s side;
Saviour, we are Thine.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Jesus, Thou hast bought us 
Not with gold or gem, 
But with Thine own life-blood, 
For Thy diadem. 
With Thy blessing filling 
Each who comes to Thee 
Thou hast made us willing, 
Thou hast made us free. 
By Thy grand redemption, 
By Thy grace divine, 
We are on the Lord’s side;
Saviour, we are Thine.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Fierce may be the conflict, 
Strong may be the foe, 
But the King’s own army 
None can overthrow; 
Round His standard ranging 
Victory is secure; 
For His truth unchanging 
Makes the triumph sure. 
Joyfully enlisting, 
By Thy grace divine, 
We are on the Lord’s side;
Saviour, we are Thine.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Chosen to be soldiers 
In an alien land, 
Chosen, called, and faithful, 
For our Captain’s band; 
In the service royal 
Let us not grow cold, 
Let us be right loyal,
Noble, true, and bold. 
Master, Thou wilt keep us, 
By Thy grace divine, 
Always on the Lord’s side, 
Saviour, always Thine.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Far away in the depths
Of my spirit tonight
Rolls a melody sweeter than psalm;
In celestial-like strains
It unceasingly falls
O'er my soul like an infinite calm.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Peace, peace, wonderful peace,
Coming down from the Father above!
Sweep over my spirit forever, I pray
In fathomless billows of love!
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
What a treasure I have
In this wonderful peace,
Buried deep in the heart of my soul,
So secure that no power
Can mine it away,
While the years of eternity roll!
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Peace, peace, wonderful peace,
Coming down from the Father above!
Sweep over my spirit forever, I pray
In fathomless billows of love!
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
I am resting tonight
In this wonderful peace,
Resting sweetly in Jesus' control;
For I'm kept from all danger
By night and by day,
And His glory is flooding my soul!
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Peace, peace, wonderful peace,
Coming down from the Father above!
Sweep over my spirit forever, I pray
In fathomless billows of love!
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
And I think when I rise
To that city of peace,
Where the anchor of peace I shall see,
That one strain of the song
Which the ransomed will sing
In that heavenly kingdom will be:
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Peace, peace, wonderful peace,
Coming down from the Father above!
Sweep over my spirit forever, I pray
In fathomless billows of love!
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Ah, soul! are you here
Without comfort and rest,
Marching down the rough pathway of time?
Make Jesus your friend
Ere the shadows grow dark;
O accept this sweet peace so sublime!
slides.label: Verse 5

slides.text:
Peace, peace, wonderful peace,
Coming down from the Father above!
Sweep over my spirit forever, I pray
In fathomless billows of love!
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Sing them over again to me,
Wonderful words of life,
Let me more of their beauty see,
Wonderful words of life;
Words of life and beauty
Teach me faith and duty.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Beautiful words, wonderful words,
Wonderful words of life,
Beautiful words, wonderful words,
Wonderful words of life.
slides.label: Chorus
Verse 2

Beautiful words, wonderful words,
Wonderful words of life,
Beautiful words, wonderful words,
Wonderful words of life.
slides.label: Chorus
Verse 3

title: Work, for the Night Is Coming
author: Anna L. Coghill

slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Work, for the night is coming,
Work through the sunny noon;
Fill brightest hours with labor,
Rest comes sure and soon.
Give every flying minute,
Something to keep in store;
Work, for the night is coming,
When man works no more.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Work, for the night is coming,
Under the sunset skies;
While their bright tints are glowing,
Work, for daylight flies.
Work till the last beam fadeth,
Fadeth to shine no more;
Work, while the night is darkening,
When man's work is o'er.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Ye holy angel bright,
Who wait at God’s right hand, 
Or through the realms of light 
Fly at your Lord’s command, 
Assist our song, 
Or else the theme too high 
Doth seem for mortal tongue.
Ye blessed souls at rest, 
Who see your Saviour’s face, 
Whose glory, e’en the least 
Is far above our grace, 
God’s praises sound, 
As in His sight 
With sweet delight 
Ye do abound.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Ye saints who toil below, 
Adore your heavenly King, 
And onward as ye go, 
Some joyful anthem sing; 
Take what He gives, 
And praise Him still 
Through good and ill, 
Who ever lives.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
My soul, bear thou thy part, 
Triumph in God above, 
And with a well-tuned heart 
Sing thou the songs of love. 
Let all thy days 
Till life shall end, 
Whate’er He send, 
Be filled with praise.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
A ruler once came to Jesus by night
To ask Him the way of salvation and light;
The Master made answer in words true and plain,
Ye must be born again.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
Ye must be born again,
Ye must be born again,
I verily, verily, say unto thee,
Ye must be born again.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Ye children of men, attend to the Word,
So solemnly uttered by Jesus the Lord;
And let not this message to you be in vain,
Ye must be born again.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Ye must be born again,
Ye must be born again,
I verily, verily, say unto thee,
Ye must be born again.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
O ye who would enter that glorious rest,
And sing with the ransomed the song of the blest,
The life everlasting if ye would obtain,
Ye must be born again.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Ye must be born again,
Ye must be born again,
I verily, verily, say unto thee,
Ye must be born again.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
A dear one in Heaven thy heart yearns to see,
At the beautiful gate may be watching for thee,
Then list to the note of this solemn refrain,
Ye must be born again.
slides.label: Verse 4

slides.text:
Ye must be born again,
Ye must be born again,
I verily, verily, say unto thee,
Ye must be born again.
slides.label: Chorus

slides.text:
Ye servants of God,
Your Master proclaim, 
And publish abroad 
His wonderful name; 
The name all-victorious 
Of Jesus extol; 
His kingdom is glorious 
And rules over all.
slides.label: Verse 1

slides.text:
God ruleth on high, 
Almighty to save; 
And still He is nigh, 
His presence we have; 
The great congregation 
His triumph shall sing, 
Ascribing salvation 
To Jesus our King.
slides.label: Verse 2

slides.text:
Salvation to God, 
Who sits on the throne! 
Let all cry aloud, 
And honour the Son; 
The praises of Jesus 
The angels proclaim, 
Fall down on their faces, 
And worship the Lamb.
slides.label: Verse 3

slides.text:
Then let us adore, 
And give Him His right, 
All glory and power, 
All wisdom and might, 
All honour and blessing, 
With angels above, 
And thanks never ceasing, 
And infinite love.
slides.label: Verse 4
